You have taken my friends away from me. You have made them disgusted with me. I am trapped and cannot escape.
My eyes are weak from sorrow. LORD, I call to you every day. I lift up my hands to you.
Do you do miracles for the dead? Do the dead get up and praise you? Selah.
Is your faithful love spoken of in the grave, or your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
Are your wonders known in the darkness, or your goodness in the land where people are forgotten?
But I cry to you for help, LORD. Every morning my prayer comes to you.
LORD, why do you reject me? Why do you hide your face from me?
I have suffered and been close to death since I was young. Your terrors have left me desperate.
Your burning anger has swept over me. Your terrors have destroyed me.
They surround me like a flood all day long. They have closed in on me completely.
You have taken my loved ones and friends away from me. Darkness is my closest friend.
A thoughtful psalm of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing about the LORD's faithful love forever. With my mouth I will make your faithfulness known to all generations.
I will say, "Your love stands firm forever. You set up the skies, and your faithfulness is in them."
You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one. I have made a promise to my servant David:
'I will make your family line last forever. I will make your throne secure for all generations.'" Selah.
LORD, the heavens praise your wonders, and your faithfulness is praised in the meeting of the holy ones.
Who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared. He is more awesome than all who surround him.
LORD God of Armies, who is as mighty as you, LORD? Your faithfulness surrounds you.
You rule over the raging sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
You crushed Rahab like someone killed in battle. With your strong arm you scattered your enemies.
The heavens belong to you, and so does the earth. You made the world and everything in it.
You created the north and the south. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon sing for joy at your name.
Your arm is powerful. Your hand is strong. Your right hand is lifted high.
Your throne is built on what is right and fair. Faithful love and truth go ahead of you.
Happy are the people who have learned to shout praise to you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.
They celebrate your name all day long. They are lifted up because you do what is right.
You are their glorious strength. Because of your kindness, our strength is lifted high.
Our shield belongs to the LORD. Our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.
Long ago you spoke in a vision to your faithful people. You said, "I have given strength to a warrior. I have lifted up a young man chosen from among the people.
I have found my servant David. I have poured my holy oil on him to make him king.
My hand will hold him up. My arm will make him strong.
No enemy will make him pay taxes. No wicked person will crush him.
I will crush his enemies in front of him and strike down those who hate him.
My faithfulness and faithful love will be with him. Because of my name, his strength will be lifted high.
I will put his hand over the sea and his right hand over the rivers.
He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the rock who saves me.'
I will make him my firstborn son, the greatest of the kings of the earth.
I will always keep my faithful love for him. My covenant with him will never fail.
I will make his family line last forever and his throne as long as the heavens last.
If his children turn away from my law and do not follow my rules,
if they break my laws and do not keep my commands,
then I will punish their sin with a rod and their wrongdoing with beatings.
But I will never take my faithful love away from him, or let my faithfulness fail.
I will not break my covenant or change what my lips have said.
I have made a promise by my holiness once and for all, and I will not lie to David.
His family line will last forever. His throne will last like the sun in front of me.
It will be set firmly in place forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.
But now you have rejected and refused him. You have been angry with your anointed king.
You have broken your covenant with your servant. You have thrown his crown in the dust.
You have broken down all his walls. You have turned his fortresses into ruins.
Everyone who passes by robs him. His neighbours insult him.
You have made his enemies strong. You have made all his enemies celebrate.
You have turned back the edge of his sword. You have not helped him in battle.
You have ended his glory and thrown his throne to the ground.
You have cut short the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your anger keep burning like fire?
Remember how short my life is. You have made all people for such a short time!
Who can live and never die? Who can escape the power of the grave? Selah.
Lord, where is your faithful love of long ago, which you promised to David in your faithfulness?
Lord, remember how your servants have been insulted. I carry in my heart the insults of all the powerful nations.
Your enemies have insulted me, LORD. They have mocked every step of your anointed king.
Praise the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
A prayer of Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our home through all generations.
Before the mountains were born, before you made the earth and the world, you are God, from forever in the past to forever in the future.
You turn people back to dust. You say, "Go back to dust, you humans."
To you, a thousand years are like yesterday that has just gone by, like a few hours in the night.
You sweep people away like a dream. They are like new grass in the morning.
In the morning it springs up and grows, but by evening it dries up and dies.
We are destroyed by your anger. We are terrified by your fury.
You have put our sins in front of you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
All our days pass away under your anger. Our years end with a sigh.
We live for seventy years, or eighty if we are strong. But even our best years are full of hard work and sorrow. They quickly pass, and we fly away.
Who understands the power of your anger? Your fury is as great as the fear you deserve.
Teach us to count our days carefully, so that we may have wise hearts.
Turn back to us, LORD! How long will it be? Have pity on your servants!
Satisfy us every morning with your faithful love, so we can sing for joy and be glad all our lives.
Make us glad for as many days as you have made us suffer, for as many years as we have seen trouble.
Let your servants see what you do. Let their children see your glory.
May the kindness of the Lord our God be on us. Make the work of our hands succeed. Yes, make the work of our hands succeed.
Whoever lives in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say about the LORD, "He is my safe place and my fortress, my God, whom I trust."
He will save you from the hunter's trap and from deadly disease.
He will cover you with his feathers. You will find safety under his wings. His faithfulness will be your shield and your wall.
You will not be afraid of the terrors of the night, or the arrow that flies by day,
or the disease that moves in the dark, or the disaster that destroys at noon.
A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.
You will only watch with your eyes and see the wicked punished.
Because you have made the LORD your safe place, and the Most High your home,
no harm will come to you. No disaster will come near your tent.
He will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
They will lift you up in their hands so you will not hit your foot against a stone.
You will walk on lions and cobras. You will trample young lions and snakes.
The LORD says, "Because he loves me, I will rescue him. I will protect him, because he knows my name.
When he calls to me, I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will rescue him and honour him.
I will satisfy him with a long life and show him how I save."
A psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to thank the LORD and to sing praises to your name, Most High,
to tell about your faithful love every morning and your faithfulness every night,
with the music of the ten-stringed lute and the harp, and the sound of the lyre.
LORD, you make me glad by what you have done. I sing for joy about the works of your hands.
LORD, how great are the things you do! Your thoughts are very deep.
A senseless person does not know this. A fool does not understand it:
Though wicked people spring up like grass and evil people all do well, they will be destroyed forever.
But you, LORD, are honoured on high forever.
Your enemies, LORD, your enemies will surely die. All evil people will be scattered.
But you have made me as strong as a wild ox. You have poured fresh oil on me.
My eyes have seen my enemies defeated. My ears have heard about the downfall of the wicked who attack me.
Good people will grow like palm trees. They will grow tall like the cedars of Lebanon.
They are planted in the LORD's house. They will grow strong in the courtyards of our God.
Even when they are old, they will still produce fruit. They will stay healthy and green,
to show that the LORD is fair. He is my rock, and there is nothing wrong in him.
The LORD rules! He is dressed in majesty. The LORD is dressed in strength. The world is firmly in place. It cannot be moved.
Your throne was set up long ago. You have always existed.
The seas have risen up, LORD. The seas have raised their voice. The seas lift up their pounding waves.
The LORD on high is mightier than the roar of many waters, mightier than the crashing waves of the sea.
Your laws stand firm. Holiness fills your house, LORD, forever.
LORD, you are the God who punishes. God who punishes, shine out!
Rise up, judge of the earth. Pay back proud people what they deserve.
LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked celebrate?
They pour out proud words. All evil people boast.
They crush your people, LORD. They hurt the people who belong to you.
They kill widows and foreigners. They murder children who have no father.
They say, "The LORD does not see. The God of Jacob does not notice."
Think about it, you senseless people! You fools, when will you become wise?
The one who made the ear, can't he hear? The one who formed the eye, can't he see?
The one who corrects the nations, won't he punish? The one who teaches people knows everything.
The LORD knows people's thoughts. He knows they are only a breath.
Happy is the person you correct, LORD, the one you teach from your law.
You give him rest from times of trouble, until a pit is dug to catch the wicked.
The LORD will not reject his people. He will not leave those who belong to him.
Judgment will again be fair, and all whose hearts are honest will follow it.
Who will stand up for me against the wicked? Who will take my side against evil people?
If the LORD had not helped me, I would soon have gone to the silent grave.
When I said, "My foot is slipping!" your faithful love, LORD, held me up.
When I was full of worries, your comfort brought me joy.
Can rulers who are evil be your partners, rulers who use the law to cause trouble?
They join together against good people and sentence innocent people to death.
But the LORD has been my high tower. My God is the rock where I find safety.
He will pay them back for their sins and destroy them for their evil. The LORD our God will destroy them.
Come, let's sing for joy to the LORD! Let's shout out loud to the rock who saves us!
Let's come to him with thanks. Let's praise him with songs!
The LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
He holds the deepest parts of the earth in his hand. The mountain peaks belong to him.
The sea is his, because he made it. His hands formed the dry land.
Come, let's bow down and worship him. Let's kneel in front of the LORD, our Maker.
He is our God. We are the people he takes care of, the sheep in his care. Today, if only you would listen to his voice!
He says, "Do not make your hearts stubborn as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the wilderness.
There your ancestors tested me and tried my patience, even though they had seen what I did.
For forty years I was angry with that generation. I said, 'Their hearts always go the wrong way. They do not know my ways.'
So in my anger I made a promise: 'They will never enter my place of rest.'"
Sing a new song to the LORD! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Sing to the LORD and praise his name! Tell every day how he saves!
Tell the nations about his glory. Tell all peoples about the amazing things he does.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise! He should be feared more than all gods.
All the gods of the nations are just idols, but the LORD made the skies.
Honour and majesty are all around him. Strength and beauty fill his holy place.
Give honour to the LORD, all you families of the nations. Give honour to the LORD for his glory and strength.
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves. Bring an offering and come into his courtyards.
Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. Tremble in front of him, all the earth.
Tell the nations, "The LORD rules!" The world is firmly in place. It cannot be moved. He will judge the peoples fairly.
Let the skies be glad and the earth celebrate! Let the sea and everything in it roar!
Let the fields and everything in them be full of joy! Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
in front of the LORD, because he is coming. He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly and the peoples with his truth.
The LORD rules! Let the earth celebrate! Let the many islands be glad!
Clouds and darkness surround him. His throne is built on what is right and fair.
Fire goes out ahead of him and burns up his enemies all around.
His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees it and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax in front of the LORD, in front of the Lord of all the earth.
The skies announce that he does what is right. All peoples see his glory.
Let all who worship idols be put to shame, all who boast about their worthless gods. All you gods, bow down to him!
Zion hears and is glad. The towns of Judah celebrate because of your judgments, LORD.
You, LORD, are the Most High over all the earth. You are far above all gods.
You who love the LORD, hate evil! He protects the lives of his faithful people. He rescues them from the power of the wicked.
Light shines on good people, and joy on those whose hearts are honest.
Be glad in the LORD, you who do what is right! Praise his holy name.
A psalm. Sing a new song to the LORD, because he has done amazing things! His right hand and his holy arm have won the victory.
The LORD has made his saving power known. He has shown the nations that he does what is right.
He has remembered his faithful love and his faithfulness to the people of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen our God save his people.
Shout with joy to the LORD, all the earth! Burst into songs of joy and praise!
Make music to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing.
With trumpets and the sound of the ram's horn, shout with joy in front of the LORD, the King.
Let the sea and everything in it roar, and the world and everyone who lives in it.
Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
Let them sing in front of the LORD, because he is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world fairly and the peoples with justice.
The LORD rules! Let the nations tremble. He sits on his throne between the cherubim. Let the earth shake.
The LORD is great in Zion. He is honoured above all the nations.
Let them praise your great and amazing name. He is holy!
The King is mighty and loves justice. You have set up fairness. You have done what is right and fair in Jacob.
Honour the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is holy!
Moses and Aaron were among his priests. Samuel was among those who called on his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud. They kept the laws and rules he gave them.
LORD our God, you answered them. You were a God who forgave them, even though you punished them for their wrong actions.
Honour the LORD our God. Worship at his holy hill, because the LORD our God is holy!
A psalm for giving thanks. Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth!
Serve the LORD with gladness. Come to him with singing.
Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him. We are his people, the sheep he takes care of.
Come through his gates with thanks. Come into his courtyards with praise. Thank him and praise his name.
The LORD is good. His faithful love lasts forever. His faithfulness continues for all generations.
A psalm of David. I will sing about your faithful love and justice. LORD, I will sing praises to you.
I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will live in my own house with a blameless heart.
I will not look at anything shameful. I hate what unfaithful people do. I will have nothing to do with it.
I will keep away from a twisted heart. I will have nothing to do with evil.
I will silence anyone who secretly tells lies about a neighbour. I will not put up with anyone who has proud eyes and a proud heart.
I will look for faithful people in the land, so they can live with me. Those who live blameless lives will serve me.
No one who cheats will live in my house. No one who tells lies will stay in my presence.
Every morning I will silence all the wicked in the land. I will remove every evil person from the city of the LORD.
A prayer of someone who is suffering and worn out, as he pours out his troubles to the LORD. LORD, hear my prayer! Let my cry for help come to you.
Do not hide your face from me when I am in trouble. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly when I call.
My days disappear like smoke. My bones burn like glowing coals.
My heart is crushed and dried up like grass. I even forget to eat.
Because of my loud groaning, I am nothing but skin and bones.
I am like a desert owl, like an owl living among ruins.
I lie awake. I am like a lonely bird on a roof.
My enemies insult me all day long. Those who make fun of me use my name as a curse.
I eat ashes as my food and mix my drinks with tears
because of your great anger, because you picked me up and threw me away.
My days are like the evening shadow that fades away. I dry up like grass.
But you, LORD, sit on your throne forever. Your fame lasts for all generations.
You will get up and show mercy to Zion. It is time to be kind to her. The time you set has come.
Your servants love even the stones of her ruins. They feel sorry for her dust.
The nations will respect the name of the LORD. All the kings of the earth will respect your glory.
The LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.
He will answer the prayer of those who have nothing. He will not ignore their prayer.
Let this be written down for the next generation, so people not yet born will praise the LORD.
Tell them the LORD looked down from his holy place on high. From heaven he looked at the earth
to hear the groans of the prisoners and to set free those sentenced to death.
Then people will talk about the name of the LORD in Zion and praise him in Jerusalem,
when the nations and kingdoms gather together to serve the LORD.
In the middle of my life he took away my strength. He cut my life short.
So I said, "My God, do not take me away in the middle of my life. Your years go on through all generations.
Long ago you laid the foundations of the earth. The skies are the work of your hands.
They will disappear, but you will remain. They will all wear out like clothes. You will change them like a coat, and they will be thrown away.
But you stay the same. Your years will never end.
The children of your servants will live in safety. Their descendants will be secure in your presence."
Of David. Praise the LORD, my soul! Everything in me, praise his holy name!
Praise the LORD, my soul, and do not forget all the good things he does.
He forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.
He rescues your life from the grave and crowns you with faithful love and mercy.
He satisfies you with good things, so that you feel young and strong again, like an eagle.
The LORD does what is right and gives justice to all who are treated cruelly.
He showed his ways to Moses and his mighty acts to the people of Israel.
The LORD is full of mercy and kindness. He is slow to get angry and full of faithful love.
He will not always accuse us. He will not stay angry forever.
He does not punish us as our sins deserve, or pay us back for the wrong things we have done.
As high as the skies are above the earth, that is how great his faithful love is for those who respect him.
As far as the east is from the west, that is how far he has taken our sins away from us.
As a father has mercy on his children, the LORD has mercy on those who respect him.
He knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.
Human life is like grass. People grow like flowers in a field.
When the wind blows over them, they are gone, and no one remembers where they were.
But the LORD's faithful love lasts forever and ever for those who respect him. His goodness continues to their grandchildren,
to those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his commands.
The LORD has set up his throne in heaven. His kingdom rules over everything.
Praise the LORD, you mighty angels who do what he says and obey his word.
Praise the LORD, all his armies of heaven, you servants who do what he wants.
Praise the LORD, everything he has made, everywhere in his kingdom. Praise the LORD, my soul!
Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, you are very great. You are dressed in honour and majesty.
He wraps himself in light like a robe. He stretches out the skies like a tent.
He sets the beams of his upstairs rooms on the waters above. He makes the clouds his chariot. He rides on the wings of the wind.
He makes the winds his messengers, and flames of fire his servants.
He set the earth on its foundations, so it can never be moved.
You covered it with the deep sea like a robe. The waters stood above the mountains.
But when you warned them, the waters ran away. At the sound of your thunder they hurried off.
The mountains rose up, and the valleys sank down to the places you had set for them.
You set a border the waters cannot cross, so they will never again cover the earth.
He makes springs pour water into the valleys. It flows between the mountains.
The springs give water to all the wild animals. The wild donkeys satisfy their thirst.
The birds of the sky build nests beside the waters. They sing among the branches.
He waters the mountains from his rooms above. The earth is filled with the good things you make.
He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to grow, so they can get food from the earth:
wine that makes people's hearts glad, oil that makes their faces shine, and bread that gives them strength.
The LORD's trees get plenty of water, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
Birds build their nests there. The stork makes its home in the pine trees.
The high mountains belong to the wild goats. The rocks are a place of safety for the rock badgers.
He made the moon to mark the seasons. The sun knows when to go down.
You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the animals of the forest come out to hunt.
The young lions roar for their prey. They look to God for their food.
When the sun rises, they slip away and lie down in their dens.
Then people go out to their work and labour until evening.
LORD, how many things you have made! You made them all with wisdom. The earth is full of your creatures.
There is the sea, huge and wide, full of more creatures than anyone can count, living things both large and small.
There the ships sail, and there is Leviathan, which you made to play in the sea.
All of them look to you to give them their food at the right time.
When you give it to them, they gather it up. When you open your hand, they are filled with good things.
When you hide your face, they are terrified. When you take away their breath, they die and go back to the dust.
When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you make the face of the earth new.
May the glory of the LORD last forever. May the LORD be glad about what he has made.
He looks at the earth, and it shakes. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
I will sing to the LORD all my life. I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
May my thoughts please him. I will be glad in the LORD.
Let sinners disappear from the earth. Let the wicked be gone forever. Praise the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD! Call on his name! Tell the nations what he has done.
Sing to him! Sing praises to him! Tell about all the amazing things he has done.
Be proud of his holy name. Let the hearts of those who look for the LORD be glad.
Look to the LORD and his strength. Always look for his face.
Remember the amazing things he has done, his miracles and the judgments he spoke,
you descendants of his servant Abraham, you children of Jacob, his chosen people.
He is the LORD our God. His judgments are over all the earth.
He remembers his covenant forever, the promise he made for a thousand generations.
It is the covenant he made with Abraham, the promise he made to Isaac.
He confirmed it to Jacob as a law, to Israel as a covenant that lasts forever.
He said, "I will give you the land of Canaan as your share, as your own property."
At that time there were only a few of them, very few, and they were strangers in the land.
They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
He did not let anyone treat them badly. He warned kings because of them:
"Do not touch my anointed ones! Do not harm my prophets!"
He called for a famine on the land and destroyed all their food supplies.
He sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who was sold as a slave.
They hurt his feet with chains, and his neck was put in irons,
until what he had predicted came true, and the LORD's word proved him right.
The king sent for him and set him free. The ruler of nations let him go.
He put him in charge of his household and made him ruler over everything he owned,
to give orders to his officials as he pleased and to teach his advisers wisdom.
Then Israel came to Egypt. Jacob lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
The LORD made his people grow in number and made them stronger than their enemies.
He turned the Egyptians' hearts to hate his people, to plot against his servants.
He sent his servant Moses, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.
They did his miraculous signs among the Egyptians, his wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent darkness and made the land dark. They did not rebel against his words.
He turned their water into blood and made their fish die.
Their land was overrun with frogs, even in the bedrooms of their kings.
He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and gnats filled their whole country.
He gave them hail instead of rain, with lightning flashing across their land.
He destroyed their grapevines and fig trees and smashed the trees all over their country.
He spoke, and locusts came, and grasshoppers too many to count.
They ate every plant in their land and ate up all their crops.
Then he struck down all the firstborn sons in their land, the first children of their strength.
He brought Israel out, loaded with silver and gold. No one among his tribes stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they left, because the Egyptians were terrified of them.
He spread out a cloud to cover them and gave them fire to light up the night.
They asked, and he brought them quails. He satisfied them with bread from heaven.
He split open the rock, and water gushed out. It flowed like a river in the desert.
He remembered his holy promise to his servant Abraham.
He brought his people out with joy, his chosen ones with shouts of happiness.
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took over what others had worked for,
so they would keep his laws and obey his teachings. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD! Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Who can tell all the mighty things the LORD has done, or praise him as much as he deserves?
Happy are those who do what is fair, who always do what is right.
LORD, remember me when you show kindness to your people. Come and save me,
so I can see your chosen people do well, share in the joy of your nation, and celebrate with the people who belong to you.
We have sinned, just as our ancestors did. We have done wrong. We have done evil.
When our ancestors were in Egypt, they did not understand your miracles. They did not remember your many acts of faithful love. Instead, they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.
But he saved them for the honour of his name, to show his mighty power.
He gave a command to the Red Sea, and it dried up. He led them through the deep waters as if they were a desert.
He saved them from those who hated them. He rescued them from the power of the enemy.
The water covered their enemies. Not one of them was left.
Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.
But they quickly forgot what he had done. They did not wait for his advice.
In the wilderness they gave in to their cravings. In the desert they tested God.
So he gave them what they asked for, but he also sent a disease that made them waste away.
In the camp they became jealous of Moses and of Aaron, the LORD's holy priest.
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan. It buried Abiram and his group.
Fire broke out among their followers. Flames burned up the wicked.
At Mount Horeb they made a calf. They bowed down to a metal idol.
They traded the glory of God for an image of a bull that eats grass.
They forgot God, who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,
amazing things in the land of Ham, and terrifying things at the Red Sea.
So he said he would destroy them. But Moses, his chosen one, stood in the gap in front of him to turn his anger away, so he would not destroy them.
Then they refused to go into the beautiful land. They did not believe his promise.
They complained in their tents and would not listen to the LORD.
So he lifted his hand and promised that he would make them die in the wilderness,
that he would make their descendants die among the nations and scatter them in other lands.
They joined in worshipping the god Baal at Peor. They ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
They made the LORD angry with what they did, and a terrible disease broke out among them.
But Phinehas stood up and stepped in, and the disease was stopped.
This was counted as right for him, for all generations to come.
At the waters of Meribah they made the LORD angry, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
They rebelled against God's Spirit, and Moses spoke without thinking.
They did not destroy the nations as the LORD had commanded them.
Instead, they mixed with the nations and learned to do what they did.
They worshipped their idols, which became a trap for them.
They even sacrificed their sons and daughters to demons.
They killed innocent people, their own sons and daughters, and sacrificed them to the idols of Canaan. The land was made unclean by their blood.
They made themselves unclean by what they did. They were unfaithful to God like a woman who sells her body.
So the LORD was furious with his people. He was disgusted with those who belonged to him.
He handed them over to the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.
Their enemies crushed them and brought them under their power.
Many times he rescued them, but they kept rebelling against him with their own plans. They sank lower and lower because of their sin.
But he still saw their trouble when he heard their cry.
He remembered his covenant with them. Because of his great and faithful love, he changed his mind.
He made all those who held them captive feel sorry for them.
LORD our God, save us. Gather us from among the nations, so we can thank your holy name and celebrate as we praise you.
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, from forever in the past to forever in the future. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let those the LORD has rescued say so, those he rescued from the power of the enemy,
those he gathered from other lands, from the east and the west, from the north and the south.
Some wandered in the wilderness, on desert paths. They found no city to live in.
They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives were slipping away.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he rescued them from their distress.
He led them on a straight path to a city where they could live.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
He satisfies those who are thirsty. He fills the hungry with good things.
Some sat in darkness and deep gloom, prisoners suffering in iron chains,
because they had rebelled against God's words and rejected the advice of the Most High.
So he humbled them with hard work. They fell down, and no one helped them.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
He brought them out of darkness and deep gloom and broke their chains.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
He breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.
Some were foolish and suffered because of their rebellion and their sins.
They could not stand the sight of food. They came close to the gates of death.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.
He sent out his word and healed them. He rescued them from the grave.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
Let them offer sacrifices of thanks and tell about what he has done with songs of joy.
Some went out to sea in ships, doing business on the great waters.
They saw what the LORD can do, his amazing works in the deep sea.
He spoke, and a storm wind rose up and lifted the waves high.
The ships rose up to the sky and went down to the depths. The sailors lost their courage in their danger.
They rolled and staggered like drunks. They did not know what to do.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.
He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves became still.
They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to the harbour they wanted.
Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for the amazing things he does for people!
Let them honour him in the gathering of the people and praise him in the meeting of the leaders.
He turns rivers into desert and flowing springs into thirsty ground.
He turns fruitful land into a salty wasteland, because of the evil of the people who live there.
He turns the desert into pools of water and dry ground into flowing springs.
He brings the hungry to live there, and they build a city to live in.
They plant fields and vineyards, and gather a rich harvest.
He blesses them, and their numbers grow greatly. He does not let their herds get smaller.
Then their numbers become fewer, and they are humbled by cruelty, trouble, and sorrow.
He pours shame on rulers and makes them wander in a wasteland with no paths.
But he lifts the needy out of their suffering and makes their families grow like flocks of sheep.
Honest people see it and are glad, and all the wicked shut their mouths.
Whoever is wise, let them think about these things and consider the faithful love of the LORD.
A song. A psalm of David. My heart is steady, God. I will sing and make music with all my soul.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
LORD, I will thank you among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.
Your faithful love is higher than the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.
God, be honoured above the skies! Let your glory be over all the earth.
Save us with your right hand and answer us, so the people you love may be rescued.
God has spoken from his holy place: "I will win! I will divide up Shechem and measure out the Valley of Succoth.
Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet. Judah is my sceptre.
Moab is my washbowl. I will throw my sandal on Edom to show I own it. I will shout in victory over Philistia."
Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
God, haven't you rejected us? You no longer go out with our armies, God.
Help us against the enemy, because human help is useless.
With God we will fight bravely, and he will trample down our enemies.
For the music director. A psalm of David. God, the one I praise, do not stay silent.
Wicked people and liars have opened their mouths against me. They have spoken lies about me.
They surround me with words of hatred. They attack me for no reason.
In return for my love they accuse me, but I keep praying.
They pay me back evil for good and hatred for my love.
They say, "Appoint a wicked person to judge him. Let an accuser stand at his right side.
When he is put on trial, let him be found guilty. Let even his prayers be counted as sin.
Let his life be short. Let someone else take his position.
Let his children lose their father, and his wife become a widow.
Let his children wander around begging. Let them be driven from their ruined homes.
Let the people he owes money to take everything he has. Let strangers steal everything he worked for.
Let no one be kind to him or feel sorry for his children who have no father.
Let his family line come to an end. Let their names be wiped out in the next generation.
Let the LORD remember the sins of his ancestors. Do not let the sin of his mother be wiped away.
Let the LORD always keep their sins in mind, so he may wipe out any memory of them from the earth."
For he never thought of being kind. He chased the poor, the needy, and those with broken hearts to kill them.
He loved to curse others, so let curses come back on him. He never wanted to bless others, so let blessings be far from him.
He wore cursing like his clothes. Let it soak into his body like water, into his bones like oil.
Let it be like a robe wrapped around him, like a belt he always wears.
May this be how the LORD pays back my accusers, those who speak evil against me.
But you, GOD the Lord, help me for the honour of your name. Rescue me because your faithful love is good.
I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded deep inside me.
I am fading away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.
My knees are weak from going without food. My body is thin and bony.
I have become a joke to my accusers. When they see me, they shake their heads.
Help me, LORD my God. Save me because of your faithful love.
Let them know that it is your hand, that you, LORD, have done it.
They may curse, but you will bless. When they attack, they will be put to shame, but I, your servant, will be glad.
Let my accusers be dressed in disgrace. Let them wrap themselves in shame like a robe.
With my mouth I will greatly thank the LORD. I will praise him in front of the great crowd.
He stands at the right side of those in need, to save them from those who would condemn them.
A psalm of David. The LORD says to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."
The LORD will stretch out your powerful sceptre from Zion. Rule over your enemies!
Your people will gladly offer themselves on the day you lead your army, dressed in holy splendour. Your young men will come to you like dew from the womb of the dawn.
The LORD has made a promise and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, like Melchizedek."
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings on the day of his anger.
He will judge the nations and fill the battlefields with dead bodies. He will crush rulers all over the earth.
He will drink from a stream beside the road, and so he will lift his head high in victory.
Praise the LORD! I will thank the LORD with all my heart, in the meeting of honest people and in the gathering of his people.
The things the LORD does are great. All who enjoy them think deeply about them.
What he does is full of glory and majesty. His goodness lasts forever.
He has made his amazing works unforgettable. The LORD is kind and full of mercy.
He gives food to those who respect him. He always remembers his covenant.
He has shown his people the power of his works by giving them the lands of other nations.
Everything he does is faithful and fair. All his commands can be trusted.
They stand firm forever and ever. They were given in truth and honesty.
He sent rescue to his people. He set up his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!
Respect for the LORD is where wisdom begins. All who follow his commands have good understanding. His praise lasts forever!
Praise the LORD! Happy is the person who respects the LORD, who takes great joy in his commands.
His children will be powerful in the land. The families of honest people will be blessed.
His house will be full of wealth and riches. His goodness lasts forever.
Even in darkness, light shines for honest people, for those who are kind, merciful, and good.
Good things come to those who are generous and lend freely, who do their business fairly.
They will never be shaken. Good people will be remembered forever.
They are not afraid of bad news. Their hearts are steady, because they trust in the LORD.
Their hearts are secure. They will not be afraid. In the end they will look in triumph on their enemies.
They have given freely to the poor. Their goodness lasts forever. They will be lifted up with honour.
The wicked will see this and be angry. They will grind their teeth and waste away. What the wicked want will come to nothing.
Praise the LORD! Praise him, you servants of the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD.
Let the name of the LORD be praised, now and forever.
From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD should be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations. His glory is above the skies.
Who is like the LORD our God, who sits on his throne on high,
who bends down to look at the heavens and the earth?
He lifts the poor out of the dust. He raises the needy from the rubbish heap.
He seats them with princes, with the princes of his people.
He gives the woman who has no children a home and makes her a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD!
When Israel came out of Egypt, when the family of Jacob left a people who spoke a foreign language,
Judah became God's holy place, and Israel became his kingdom.
The sea saw it and ran away. The Jordan River turned back.
The mountains jumped like rams, and the hills like lambs.
Sea, why did you run away? Jordan, why did you turn back?
Mountains, why did you jump like rams? Hills, why did you jump like lambs?
Tremble, earth, in front of the Lord, in front of the God of Jacob.
He turned the rock into a pool of water, the hard rock into a spring of water.
Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name be the glory, because of your faithful love and your truth.
Why should the nations say, "Where is their God now?"
Our God is in heaven. He does whatever he wants.
Their idols are made of silver and gold. Human hands made them.
They have mouths, but cannot speak. They have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear. They have noses, but cannot smell.
They have hands, but cannot feel. They have feet, but cannot walk. They cannot make a sound with their throats.
Those who make idols will become like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
Family of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
You who respect the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.
The LORD remembers us, and he will bless us. He will bless the family of Israel. He will bless the family of Aaron.
He will bless those who respect the LORD, both small and great.
May the LORD give you more and more children, you and your children after you.
May you be blessed by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but he has given the earth to people.
The dead do not praise the LORD, nor do those who go down into the silent grave.
But we will praise the LORD, now and forever. Praise the LORD!
I love the LORD, because he hears my voice and my cry for mercy.
Because he turned his ear to me, I will call to him as long as I live.
The ropes of death were wrapped around me. The pains of the grave took hold of me. I was overcome by trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on the name of the LORD: "LORD, please save my life!"
The LORD is kind and does what is right. Our God is full of mercy.
The LORD protects simple people. When I was brought low, he saved me.
Be at rest again, my soul, because the LORD has been good to you.
You have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from tripping.
I will walk with the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, so I said, "I am suffering terribly."
In my panic I said, "Everyone is a liar."
What can I give back to the LORD for all the good things he has done for me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
I will keep my promises to the LORD in front of all his people.
The death of his faithful people is precious in the LORD's eyes.
LORD, I truly am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have set me free from my chains.
I will offer you a sacrifice of thanks and call on the name of the LORD.
I will keep my promises to the LORD in front of all his people,
in the courtyards of the LORD's house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD, all you nations! Praise him, all you peoples!
His faithful love for us is great. The LORD's faithfulness lasts forever. Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let Israel say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
Let the family of Aaron say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
Let those who respect the LORD say, "His faithful love lasts forever."
When I was in trouble, I called to the LORD. The LORD answered me and set me free.
The LORD is with me, so I will not be afraid. What can mere people do to me?
The LORD is with me. He is my helper. I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
It is better to go to the LORD for safety than to trust in people.
It is better to go to the LORD for safety than to trust in rulers.
All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them down.
They swarmed around me like bees, but they burned out as quickly as burning thorns. In the name of the LORD I cut them down.
I was pushed hard and almost fell, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song. He has saved me.
Shouts of joy and victory are heard in the tents of good people: "The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!
The LORD's right hand is lifted high! The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!"
I will not die. I will live and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD has punished me hard, but he has not let me die.
Open the gates of goodness for me. I will go through them and thank the LORD.
This is the gate of the LORD. Good people will go through it.
I will thank you, because you answered me and saved me.
The stone the builders rejected has become the most important stone of all.
The LORD has done this, and it is amazing to us.
This is the day the LORD has made. Let's celebrate and be glad today!
LORD, please save us! LORD, please give us success!
Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD! We bless you from the house of the LORD.
The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes to the horns of the altar.
You are my God, and I will thank you. You are my God, and I will honour you.
Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Aleph. Happy are those who live blameless lives, who follow the LORD's law.
Happy are those who keep his laws and look for him with all their hearts.
They do nothing wrong. They follow his ways.
You have given us your rules so that we would obey them completely.
I wish my ways were steady in keeping your laws!
Then I would not be put to shame when I think about all your commands.
I will thank you with an honest heart as I learn your fair judgments.
I will keep your laws. Do not ever leave me.
Beth. How can a young person keep their life pure? By living as your word says.
I look for you with all my heart. Do not let me wander away from your commands.
I have stored up your word in my heart so I will not sin against you.
Praise be to you, LORD. Teach me your laws.
With my lips I tell about all the judgments you have spoken.
I enjoy following your laws as much as having great riches.
I will think about your rules and pay attention to your ways.
I take delight in your laws. I will not forget your word.
Gimel. Be good to me, your servant, so I may live and obey your word.
Open my eyes so I can see the wonderful things in your law.
I am a stranger on earth. Do not hide your commands from me.
My soul is worn out with longing for your judgments all the time.
You scold proud people who are cursed, those who wander away from your commands.
Take away the insults and shame people give me, because I have kept your laws.
Even when rulers sit together and speak against me, I, your servant, will think about your laws.
Your laws are my delight. They are my advisers.
Daleth. I am lying face down in the dust. Give me new life, as your word promises!
I told you about my life, and you answered me. Teach me your laws.
Help me understand what your rules teach. Then I will think about your amazing works.
My soul is tired and sad. Give me strength, as your word promises.
Keep me away from lies. Be kind and teach me your law.
I have chosen the way of truth. I have set my heart on your judgments.
I hold on tightly to your laws, LORD. Do not let me be put to shame.
I run along the path of your commands, because you have set my heart free.
He. Teach me, LORD, to follow your laws, and I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. I will obey it with all my heart.
Lead me along the path of your commands, because I love them.
Turn my heart toward your laws and not toward selfish gain.
Turn my eyes away from worthless things. Give me new life as I follow your ways.
Keep your promise to me, your servant, so that people will respect you.
Take away the shame I am afraid of, because your judgments are good.
Look how I long for your rules! Give me new life because you do what is right.
Vav. LORD, let your faithful love come to me, and your rescue, as you promised.
Then I will have an answer for those who insult me, because I trust in your word.
Do not take the word of truth away from my mouth, because I put my hope in your judgments.
I will always obey your law, forever and ever.
I will walk around in freedom, because I have looked for your rules.
I will speak about your laws in front of kings, and I will not be ashamed.
I take delight in your commands, because I love them.
I lift up my hands to your commands, which I love. I will think about your laws.
Zayin. Remember your promise to me, your servant, because it has given me hope.
This is my comfort when I suffer: your promise gives me life.
Proud people make fun of me terribly, but I do not turn away from your law.
LORD, I remember your judgments from long ago, and they comfort me.
I burn with anger because of the wicked, who have turned away from your law.
Your laws have been my songs in the place where I live.
LORD, I remember your name at night, and I keep your law.
This is how I live: I obey your rules.
Heth. The LORD is all I need. I have promised to obey your words.
I have looked for your kindness with all my heart. Be kind to me, as you promised.
I thought about how I was living, and I turned my steps to follow your laws.
I will hurry, without delay, to obey your commands.
The wicked have tied me up with ropes, but I will not forget your law.
At midnight I get up to thank you, because your judgments are right.
I am a friend to everyone who respects you, to everyone who obeys your rules.
LORD, the earth is full of your faithful love. Teach me your laws.
Teth. LORD, you have been good to me, your servant, as you promised.
Teach me good sense and knowledge, because I believe in your commands.
Before I suffered, I wandered off, but now I obey your word.
You are good, and you do what is good. Teach me your laws.
Proud people have smeared me with lies, but I keep your rules with all my heart.
Their hearts are hard and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.
It was good for me to suffer, so I could learn your laws.
The law you have spoken is worth more to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Yodh. Your hands made me and formed me. Give me understanding so I can learn your commands.
May those who respect you be glad when they see me, because I have put my hope in your word.
LORD, I know that your judgments are right, and that you made me suffer because you are faithful.
May your faithful love comfort me, as you promised me, your servant.
Show me your tender mercy so I may live, because your law is my delight.
Let proud people be put to shame for hurting me with lies. I will think about your rules.
Let those who respect you turn to me, those who understand your laws.
May my heart be blameless in following your laws, so I will not be put to shame.
Kaph. I am worn out waiting for you to rescue me. I put my hope in your word.
My eyes are tired from looking for what you promised. I ask, "When will you comfort me?"
I am like a wineskin dried out in the smoke, but I do not forget your laws.
How long must I, your servant, wait? When will you punish those who chase me?
Proud people have dug pits to trap me. They do not follow your law.
All your commands can be trusted. People are chasing me for no reason. Help me!
They almost wiped me off the earth, but I have not turned away from your rules.
Keep me alive because of your faithful love, so I can obey the laws you have spoken.
Lamedh. LORD, your word lasts forever. It stands firm in heaven.
Your faithfulness continues for all generations. You set the earth in place, and it stays there.
Your laws still stand today, because everything serves you.
If your law had not been my delight, I would have died in my suffering.
I will never forget your rules, because by them you have given me life.
I belong to you. Save me, because I have looked for your rules.
Wicked people are waiting to destroy me, but I will think about your laws.
I have seen that everything has its limits, but your commands have no limit.
Mem. How I love your law! I think about it all day long.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, because they are always with me.
I understand more than all my teachers, because I think about your laws.
I understand more than the old people, because I obey your rules.
I have kept my feet from every evil path, so that I can obey your word.
I have not turned away from your judgments, because you yourself have taught me.
How sweet your promises taste to me! They are sweeter than honey in my mouth.
I get understanding from your rules, so I hate every path that is false.
Nun. Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light for my path.
I have made a promise and I will keep it: I will obey your fair judgments.
I am suffering very much. LORD, give me new life, as your word promises.
LORD, please accept the praise I gladly offer, and teach me your judgments.
My life is always in danger, but I will not forget your law.
Wicked people have set a trap for me, but I have not wandered from your rules.
Your laws are my treasure forever. They are the joy of my heart.
I have set my heart on obeying your laws forever, to the very end.
Samekh. I hate people who cannot make up their minds, but I love your law.
You are my hiding place and my shield. I put my hope in your word.
Get away from me, you evil people, so I can keep the commands of my God.
Hold me up as you promised, so I will live. Do not let my hope be disappointed.
Hold me up, and I will be safe. I will always respect your laws.
You reject all who wander away from your laws, because their lies are useless.
You throw away all the wicked of the earth like waste metal. So I love your laws.
My body trembles because I am afraid of you. I am in awe of your judgments.
Ayin. I have done what is fair and right. Do not leave me to those who want to crush me.
Promise that things will go well for me, your servant. Do not let proud people crush me.
My eyes are tired from looking for your rescue, for your promise to make things right.
Treat me, your servant, with faithful love. Teach me your laws.
I am your servant. Give me understanding so I can know your laws.
LORD, it is time for you to act, because people are breaking your law.
So I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold.
So I believe all your rules are right. I hate every path that is false.
Pe. Your laws are wonderful, so I obey them with all my heart.
When your words are explained, they give light. They give understanding to simple people.
I open my mouth and pant, because I long for your commands.
Turn to me and be kind to me, as you always are to those who love your name.
Guide my steps by your word. Do not let any sin control me.
Rescue me from people who would crush me, so I can obey your rules.
Let your face shine on me, your servant. Teach me your laws.
Rivers of tears flow from my eyes, because people do not obey your law.
Tsadhe. LORD, you always do what is right, and your judgments are fair.
The laws you have given are right and completely trustworthy.
My deep love for your laws wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.
Your promises have been completely tested, and I, your servant, love them.
I am unimportant and looked down on, but I do not forget your rules.
Your goodness lasts forever, and your law is true.
Trouble and pain have come to me, but your commands are my delight.
Your laws are always right. Give me understanding so I may live.
Qoph. I call with all my heart. LORD, answer me! I will obey your laws.
I call out to you. Save me, and I will keep your laws.
I get up before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.
I stay awake through the night so I can think about your promises.
Hear my voice because of your faithful love. LORD, give me new life, as your judgments promise.
Those who plan evil are coming close to me, but they are far from your law.
But you are near, LORD, and all your commands are true.
Long ago I learned from your laws that you made them to last forever.
Resh. Look at my suffering and rescue me, because I have not forgotten your law.
Defend my cause and rescue me. Give me new life, as you promised.
Wicked people are far from being saved, because they do not look for your laws.
LORD, your mercy is great. Give me new life, as your judgments promise.
Many enemies chase and attack me, but I have not turned away from your laws.
I look at unfaithful people with disgust, because they do not obey your word.
See how I love your rules. LORD, give me new life because of your faithful love.
All your words are true. All your fair judgments last forever.
Sin and Shin. Rulers chase me for no reason, but my heart is in awe of your word.
I am happy about your promise, like someone who finds great treasure.
I hate and despise lies, but I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you because your judgments are right.
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing makes them stumble.
LORD, I hope for your rescue, and I follow your commands.
I obey your laws with all my heart. I love them very much.
I obey your rules and your laws, because you see everything I do.
Tav. LORD, let my cry come to you. Give me understanding, as your word promises.
Let my prayer come to you. Rescue me, as you promised.
Let my lips overflow with praise, because you teach me your laws.
Let my tongue sing about your word, because all your commands are right.
Let your hand be ready to help me, because I have chosen your rules.
LORD, I long for your rescue. Your law is my delight.
Let me live so I can praise you. Let your judgments help me.
I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Come and look for me, your servant, because I have not forgotten your commands.
A song for going up to worship. When I was in trouble, I cried to the LORD, and he answered me.
LORD, save me from lying lips and from tongues that deceive.
What will God do to you, you lying tongue? What more will he do to you?
He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows and with burning coals of the broom tree.
How terrible for me that I live as a stranger in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
I have lived too long among people who hate peace.
I want peace, but when I speak, they want war.
A song for going up to worship. I look up to the hills. Where does my help come from?
My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
He will not let your foot slip. The one who watches over you will not fall asleep.
Look, the one who watches over Israel never gets tired and never sleeps.
The LORD watches over you. The LORD is the shade at your right side.
The sun will not harm you by day, or the moon by night.
The LORD will keep you safe from all harm. He will watch over your life.
The LORD will watch over you as you come and go, now and forever.
A song for going up to worship. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, "Let's go to the house of the LORD!"
Jerusalem, our feet are standing inside your gates!
Jerusalem is built as a city where everything fits closely together.
The tribes go up there, the tribes of the LORD, as the law for Israel says, to thank the name of the LORD.
There the thrones for judging stand, the thrones of the family of David.
Pray for peace in Jerusalem. May those who love you be safe.
May there be peace inside your walls and safety in your palaces.
For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, "May peace be with you."
For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will work for your good.
A song for going up to worship. I look up to you, you who sit on your throne in heaven.
As servants watch their master's hand, and as a servant girl watches her mistress's hand, so our eyes look to the LORD our God until he is kind to us.
Be kind to us, LORD, be kind to us, because we have had more than enough insults.
We have had more than enough of the mocking of comfortable people and the insults of proud people.
A song for going up to worship. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side, let Israel say,
if the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,
they would have swallowed us alive when their anger burned against us.
The flood would have swept us away. The river would have flowed over us.
The raging waters would have swept us away.
Praise the LORD, who has not let their teeth tear us apart.
We have escaped like a bird from the hunter's trap. The trap has been broken, and we have escaped.
Our help comes from the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.
A song for going up to worship. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be shaken. It stands firm forever.
As the mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people now and forever.
The wicked will not keep ruling over the land given to good people, or good people might be tempted to do evil.
LORD, be good to those who are good, to those whose hearts are honest.
But those who turn to crooked ways, the LORD will drive them away with those who do evil. May there be peace in Israel.
A song for going up to worship. When the LORD brought the captives back to Zion, it was like a dream.
Our mouths were filled with laughter and our tongues with songs of joy. Then the nations said, "The LORD has done great things for them."
The LORD has done great things for us, and we are full of joy.
LORD, make us successful again, like streams that flow again in the dry Negev.
Those who plant seeds with tears will harvest with shouts of joy.
Those who go out crying, carrying seed to plant, will come back with shouts of joy, carrying bundles of grain.
A song for going up to worship. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders work for nothing. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the guards stay awake for nothing.
It is useless to get up early and stay up late, working hard for your food, because the LORD gives sleep to those he loves.
Children are a gift from the LORD. They are a reward from him.
Children born to a young man are like arrows in the hands of a warrior.
Happy is the man who has a quiver full of them. They will not be put to shame when they face their enemies at the city gate.
A song for going up to worship. Happy is everyone who respects the LORD, who follows his ways.
You will eat what your hands have worked for. You will be happy, and things will go well for you.
Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine inside your house. Your children will be like young olive trees around your table.
This is how the man who respects the LORD will be blessed.
May the LORD bless you from Zion. May you see Jerusalem do well all the days of your life.
May you live to see your grandchildren. May there be peace in Israel.
A song for going up to worship. Let Israel say: "They have attacked me many times since I was young.
They have attacked me many times since I was young, but they have never defeated me.
Ploughmen ploughed across my back. They made their rows long."
But the LORD does what is right. He has cut me free from the ropes of the wicked.
Let all who hate Zion be put to shame and turned back.
Let them be like grass on a flat roof, which dries up before it can grow,
which no one can gather into their hands or carry in their arms.
Let no one who passes by say to them, "May the LORD bless you. We bless you in the name of the LORD."
A song for going up to worship. LORD, from the depths of my trouble I cry to you.
Lord, hear my voice. Listen closely to my cry for mercy.
LORD, if you kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
But you forgive us, so we respect you.
I wait for the LORD. My whole being waits for him. I put my hope in his word.
I long for the Lord more than guards long for the morning, more than guards long for the morning.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, because with the LORD there is faithful love. He is always ready to rescue.
He himself will rescue Israel from all their sins.
A song for going up to worship. Of David. LORD, my heart is not proud, and my eyes do not look down on others. I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.
Instead, I have calmed and quieted myself, like a young child who is content with his mother. Like a contented child, I am at peace inside.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, now and forever.
A song for going up to worship. LORD, remember David and all the hardships he went through.
Remember how he made a promise to the LORD, a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:
"I will not go into my house or go to bed.
I will not let my eyes sleep or my eyelids close
until I find a place for the LORD, a home for the Mighty One of Jacob."
We heard about the ark in Ephrathah. We found it in the fields of Jaar.
"Let's go to the place where he lives. Let's worship at his footstool."
Get up, LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark that shows your strength.
May your priests be dressed in goodness. May your faithful people shout for joy!
For the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed king.
The LORD made a sure promise to David that he will not take back: "I will put one of your own descendants on your throne.
If your children keep my covenant and the laws I teach them, then their children will also sit on your throne forever."
The LORD has chosen Zion. He wanted it as his home.
He said, "This is my resting place forever. I will live here, because this is what I wanted.
I will bless it with plenty of food. I will satisfy its poor people with bread.
I will dress its priests in salvation. Its faithful people will shout for joy.
Here I will make David's power grow. I have prepared a lamp for my anointed king.
I will dress his enemies in shame, but his crown will shine."
A song for going up to worship. Of David. How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity!
It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down over the beard, down Aaron's beard, down to the collar of his robes.
It is like the dew of Mount Hermon falling on the hills of Zion. That is where the LORD gives his blessing, life that lasts forever.
A song for going up to worship. Come, praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve at night in the house of the LORD!
Lift up your hands in the holy place and praise the LORD!
May the LORD, who made heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,
you who serve in the house of the LORD, in the courtyards of the house of our God.
Praise the LORD, because the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, because that is a joy.
The LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his special treasure.
I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.
The LORD does whatever he wants in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.
He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings the wind out of his storerooms.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, both people and animals.
He sent miraculous signs and wonders among you, Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his officials.
He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings:
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.
LORD, your name lasts forever. LORD, your fame lasts for all generations.
The LORD will defend his people and show mercy to his servants.
The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold. Human hands made them.
They have mouths, but cannot speak. They have eyes, but cannot see.
They have ears, but cannot hear. There is no breath in their mouths.
Those who make idols will become like them, and so will everyone who trusts in them.
Family of Israel, praise the LORD! Family of Aaron, praise the LORD!
Family of Levi, praise the LORD! You who respect the LORD, praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD from Zion, the one who lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
Thank the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of gods. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the Lord of lords. His faithful love lasts forever.
He alone does great wonders. His faithful love lasts forever.
With his understanding he made the skies. His faithful love lasts forever.
He spread out the earth on the waters. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the great lights. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the sun to rule the day. His faithful love lasts forever.
He made the moon and stars to rule the night. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt. His faithful love lasts forever.
He brought Israel out from among them. His faithful love lasts forever.
He did it with a strong hand and a powerful arm. His faithful love lasts forever.
He split the Red Sea in two. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led Israel through the middle of it. His faithful love lasts forever.
But he swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His faithful love lasts forever.
He led his people through the wilderness. His faithful love lasts forever.
He struck down great kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed mighty kings. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed Sihon king of the Amorites. His faithful love lasts forever.
He killed Og king of Bashan. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gave their land as an inheritance. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gave it to his servant Israel. His faithful love lasts forever.
He remembered us when we were brought low. His faithful love lasts forever.
He rescued us from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.
He gives food to every living creature. His faithful love lasts forever.
Thank the God of heaven. His faithful love lasts forever.
Beside the rivers of Babylon, we sat down and cried when we remembered Zion.
We hung up our harps on the willow trees there.
Those who had taken us captive asked us to sing. Those who tormented us demanded happy songs. They said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"
How can we sing the songs of the LORD in a foreign land?
Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand forget how to play.
Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not love Jerusalem more than my greatest joy.
LORD, remember what the people of Edom did on the day Jerusalem fell. They said, "Tear it down! Tear it down to its foundations!"
People of Babylon, you will be destroyed. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you have done to us.
Happy is the one who grabs your babies and smashes them against the rocks.
Of David. I will thank you with all my heart. I will sing praises to you in front of the gods.
I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your name for your faithful love and your truth. You have made your name and your word greater than everything.
When I called, you answered me. You made me brave and strong.
All the kings of the earth will thank you, LORD, when they hear what you have said.
They will sing about the ways of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD is great.
Though the LORD is high above, he cares for humble people. But he knows proud people from far away.
Even when I walk through trouble, you keep me alive. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies. Your right hand saves me.
The LORD will do everything he has planned for me. LORD, your faithful love lasts forever. Do not abandon what your own hands have made.
For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, you have looked deep inside me, and you know me.
You know when I sit down and when I get up. You know my thoughts from far away.
You see where I go and when I lie down. You know everything I do.
Before a word is even on my tongue, LORD, you know all about it.
You surround me, behind me and in front of me. You lay your hand on me.
This knowledge is too wonderful for me. It is too great for me to understand.
Where could I go from your Spirit? Where could I run from your presence?
If I go up to heaven, you are there. If I lie down in the grave, you are there!
If I fly away on the wings of the dawn and settle on the far side of the sea,
even there your hand will guide me, and your right hand will hold me tight.
If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light around me will become night,"
even the darkness is not dark to you. The night shines as bright as the day. Darkness is like light to you.
You made every part of me. You put me together inside my mother's womb.
I praise you, because you made me in such an amazing and wonderful way. What you have done is wonderful. I know that very well.
My body was not hidden from you when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
Your eyes saw me before I was born. All the days planned for me were written in your book before any of them came to be.
God, your thoughts are so precious to me! How many there are!
If I tried to count them, they would be more than the grains of sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
God, I wish you would kill the wicked! Get away from me, you murderers!
They speak evil things about you. Your enemies misuse your name.
LORD, don't I hate those who hate you? Don't I hate those who rise up against you?
I hate them completely. They are my enemies.
Look deep inside me, God, and know my heart. Test me and know my anxious thoughts.
See if there is any evil way in me, and lead me on the path that lasts forever.
For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, rescue me from evil people. Protect me from violent people,
who plan evil in their hearts and start fights all the time.
Their tongues are as sharp as a snake's. Their words are like the poison of a viper. Selah.
LORD, keep me out of the hands of the wicked. Protect me from violent people who plan to make me trip.
Proud people have hidden a trap for me. They have spread out a net beside the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
I say to the LORD, "You are my God." LORD, hear my cry for mercy.
LORD, my Lord, my strong saviour, you protect my head on the day of battle.
LORD, do not give the wicked what they want. Do not let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
Let the heads of those who surround me be covered by the trouble their own lips have caused.
Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into deep muddy pits they can never climb out of.
Do not let people who tell lies about others succeed in the land. Let disaster hunt down violent people.
I know that the LORD will defend the cause of those who suffer and give justice to the poor.
Good people will surely praise your name. Honest people will live in your presence.
A psalm of David. LORD, I call to you. Come quickly to help me! Listen to me when I call to you.
May my prayer rise up to you like incense. May my lifted hands be like the evening sacrifice.
LORD, put a guard over my mouth. Keep watch over the door of my lips.
Do not let my heart be drawn to anything evil, to join evil people in doing wicked things. Do not let me eat their fine food.
If a good person strikes me, it is a kindness. If he corrects me, it is like oil on my head. I will not refuse it. But I keep praying against the evil things that wicked people do.
When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the wicked will hear my words and know they were true.
They will say, "As the ground is ploughed and broken up, our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave."
But my eyes are on you, LORD, my Lord. I come to you for safety. Do not leave me helpless.
Keep me from the traps they have set for me, from the traps of those who do evil.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets while I escape safely.
A thoughtful psalm of David, written when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry out loud to the LORD. I beg the LORD for mercy.
I pour out my complaint to him. I tell him all my troubles.
When my spirit grows weak inside me, you know the way I should go. On the path where I walk, people have hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see. No one cares about me. There is no place for me to hide. No one cares what happens to me.
I cry to you, LORD. I say, "You are my safe place. You are all I have in the land of the living."
Listen to my cry, because I am in desperate need. Rescue me from those who chase me, because they are too strong for me.
Set me free from my prison, so that I can praise your name. Then good people will gather around me, because you have been good to me.
A psalm of David. LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my cry for mercy. Because you are faithful and do what is right, come and help me.
Do not put me, your servant, on trial, because no one alive is right in your eyes.
The enemy chases me. He has crushed my life into the ground. He makes me live in darkness, like those who died long ago.
So my spirit grows weak inside me. My heart is full of despair.
