Women received their loved ones back from death. Others were tortured and refused to be set free, so that they would rise to a better life.
Some were laughed at and beaten with whips. Others were put in chains and thrown into prison.

Some were killed with stones, some were cut in two, and some were tempted. Some were killed with the sword. Some wandered around wearing the skins of sheep and goats. They were poor, suffering and treated badly.
The world was not good enough for them. They wandered in deserts and mountains, and lived in caves and holes in the ground.
God was pleased with all of them because of their faith, but none of them received what God had promised.
God had planned something better that includes us, so that they would only be made perfect together with us.

So we are surrounded by a huge crowd of people who have shown their faith. Let us throw off everything that holds us back, and the sin that so easily trips us up. Let us keep running the race God has set before us, and never give up.

Let us keep our eyes on Jesus. Our faith starts with him, and he makes it complete. Because of the joy waiting for him, he suffered on the cross and did not care about its shame. Now he is sitting at the right hand of God's throne.
Think about Jesus, who put up with so much hatred from sinners. Then you will not get tired and give up.
In your fight against sin, you have not yet had to fight to the point of being killed.
Have you forgotten the encouraging words God speaks to you as his children? "My child, do not think little of the Lord's discipline, and do not give up when he corrects you.
The Lord disciplines everyone he loves, and he corrects everyone he accepts as his child."
Put up with hard times as discipline. God is treating you as his children. What child is never disciplined by their father?
Everyone receives discipline. If you are never disciplined, then you are not really God's children at all.
We all had human fathers who disciplined us, and we respected them for it. So we should be even more willing to obey God, the Father of our spirits, and live!
Our fathers disciplined us for a short time, as they thought best. But God disciplines us for our good, so that we can share in his holiness.
No discipline feels nice at the time. It hurts! But later, those who have been trained by it enjoy peace and a life that is right with God.
So lift up your tired hands, and make your weak knees strong.
Make straight paths for your feet, so that weak legs will not be hurt more, but will be healed.
Try your best to live in peace with everyone, and to live a holy life. No one will see the Lord without it.
Be careful that no one misses out on God's kindness. Make sure no bitterness grows up among you like a weed, to cause trouble and spoil many people.
Make sure no one sins sexually or does not care about God, like Esau. He sold his rights as the oldest son for one meal.
You know that later he wanted his father's blessing, but he was turned away. Even though he begged for it with tears, he could not change what had happened.
You have not come to a mountain you can touch, like Mount Sinai, burning with fire, dark and gloomy, with a storm,
and with the sound of a trumpet and a voice speaking. When the people heard that voice, they begged not to hear another word.
They could not stand the command: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be killed with stones."
The sight was so terrible that Moses said, "I am shaking with fear."
Instead, you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the Jerusalem in heaven. You have come to thousands and thousands of angels, gathered with joy.

You have come to the gathering of God's firstborn children, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the Judge of all people, and to the spirits of good people who have been made perfect.
You have come to Jesus, who brings the new covenant between God and people. And you have come to his sprinkled blood, which speaks of better things than the blood of Abel.

Be careful not to refuse to listen to God, who is speaking. The people of Israel did not escape when they refused to listen to the one who warned them on earth. So we will certainly not escape if we turn away from the one who warns us from heaven!
Back then, his voice shook the earth. But now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens."
The words "once more" show that God will take away everything that can be shaken, everything he has made, so that only what cannot be shaken will remain.
We are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken. So let us be thankful, and worship God in a way that pleases him, with respect and wonder,
because our God is like a fire that burns everything up.
Keep on loving each other as brothers and sisters.
Do not forget to welcome strangers into your home. Some people who did this have welcomed angels without knowing it.
Remember those who are in prison, as if you were in prison with them. Remember those who are treated badly, as if you were suffering with them.
Everyone should respect marriage, and husband and wife must be faithful to each other. God will judge those who sin sexually and those who cheat on their marriage.
Do not love money. Be happy with what you have, because God has said, "I will never leave you. I will never turn my back on you."
So we can say with courage, "The Lord helps me. I will not be afraid. What can people do to me?"
Remember your leaders, who taught you God's word. Think about how good their lives turned out, and copy their faith.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.

Do not let all kinds of strange teachings lead you away. It is good for our hearts to be made strong by God's kindness, not by rules about food. Those rules have never helped the people who follow them.
We have an altar, and those who serve in the old tent of worship have no right to eat from it.
The high priest takes the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as an offering for sin, but the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
In the same way, Jesus suffered outside the city gate, to make the people holy through his own blood.
So let us go out to him, outside the camp, and accept the same shame he suffered.
Here on earth we do not have a city that lasts forever. We are looking for the city that is still to come.
So through Jesus, let us always offer praise to God as our sacrifice. Let our lips praise his name and show that we belong to him.
And do not forget to do good and to share with others, because God is pleased with sacrifices like these.
Obey your leaders and do what they say. They watch over your souls, and they must answer to God for their work. Help them do it with joy and not with sadness, because that would not help you.
Pray for us. We are sure our conscience is clear, and we want to live in an honest way in everything.
I especially beg you to pray, so that God will bring me back to you soon.
God gives peace. He brought our Lord Jesus back from death, the great Shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the covenant that lasts forever.
May God give you every good thing you need to do what he wants. May he work in us what pleases him, through Jesus Christ. Glory to Jesus forever and ever! Amen.
Brothers and sisters, please listen patiently to these words of encouragement, because I have only written you a short letter.
I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been let out of prison. If he comes soon, I will bring him with me when I come to see you.
Say hello to all your leaders and to all God's people. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.
May God's kindness be with you all. Amen.
Jas: From James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ. To God's people, the twelve tribes scattered around the world: Greetings.
My brothers and sisters, be very glad when you face all kinds of troubles.
You know that when your faith is tested, you learn to keep going.
Let that patience finish its work, so that you will be mature and complete, not lacking anything.
If any of you needs wisdom, ask God for it. He gives freely to everyone and does not find fault, and he will give it to you.
But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt. Someone who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
A person like that should not expect to receive anything from the Lord.
They cannot make up their mind, and they are unsteady in everything they do.
Believers who are poor should be proud, because God has lifted them up.
Rich people should be proud when God makes them humble, because they will pass away like a wild flower.
The sun rises with its burning heat and dries up the grass. The flower falls off, and its beauty is gone. In the same way, rich people will fade away, even while they are busy with their plans.
Blessed is the person who stays strong when tested. When they have passed the test, they will receive the crown of life that the Lord promised to those who love him.
When you are tempted, do not say, "God is tempting me." Evil cannot tempt God, and he does not tempt anyone.
People are tempted when their own wrong desires pull them away and trap them.
Then those desires grow and give birth to sin. And when sin is fully grown, it gives birth to death.
Do not be fooled, my dear brothers and sisters.
Every good and perfect gift comes from above, from God our Father, who made the lights in the sky. He never changes or moves like a shadow.
He chose to give us new life through his word of truth, so that we would be the first and best of everything he made.
My dear brothers and sisters, remember this: everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to get angry.
Human anger does not produce the right kind of life that God wants.
So get rid of everything dirty and all the evil around you. Humbly accept the word God has planted in your hearts. It can save you.
Do what God's word says. Do not just listen to it and fool yourselves.
Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like someone who looks at their face in a mirror.
They look at themselves, walk away, and quickly forget what they look like.
But some people look closely into God's perfect law, which sets people free, and keep doing it. They do not forget what they heard, but they do it. They will be blessed in what they do.
If you think you are religious but you do not control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is worth nothing.
Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and good is this: to care for orphans and widows in their troubles, and to keep yourself from being spoiled by the world.
My brothers and sisters, you believe in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, so do not treat some people better than others.
Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in dirty clothes also comes in.
You pay special attention to the man in fine clothes and say, "Please sit here in this good seat." But you say to the poor man, "Stand over there," or "Sit on the floor by my feet."
Then you are treating people differently, and you are judging them with evil thoughts.
Listen, my dear brothers and sisters. God chose people who are poor in this world to be rich in faith. They will receive the kingdom he promised to those who love him.
But you have shamed the poor! Is it not the rich who treat you badly and drag you into court?
Are they not the ones who insult the good name of Jesus, to whom you belong?
It is good if you really keep the royal law found in the Scriptures: "Love your neighbour as you love yourself."
But if you treat some people better than others, you are sinning. The law shows that you are guilty of breaking it.
Whoever keeps the whole law but fails in just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.
God said, "Do not cheat on your marriage." He also said, "Do not murder." So if you do not cheat on your marriage but you do murder, you have still broken the law.
Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
Anyone who has not shown mercy will be judged without mercy. But mercy wins over judgment.
My brothers and sisters, what good is it if someone says they have faith, but they do not show it by what they do? Can that kind of faith save them?
Suppose a brother or sister has no clothes and no food for the day.
If one of you says to them, "Go in peace. Keep warm and eat well," but you do not give them what they need, what good is that?
In the same way, faith by itself, if it does not lead to action, is dead.
But someone will say, "You have faith, and I have actions." Show me your faith without actions, and I will show you my faith by what I do.
You believe there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that, and they shake with fear.
You foolish person, do you want proof that faith without actions is useless?
Our ancestor Abraham was made right with God by what he did, when he offered his son Isaac on the altar.
You see that his faith and his actions worked together. His faith was made complete by what he did.
So the Scripture came true that says, "Abraham believed God, and God accepted him as right with him." And Abraham was called God's friend.
So you see that a person is made right with God by what they do, and not by faith alone.
In the same way, Rahab the prostitute was made right with God by what she did. She welcomed the spies and sent them away by a different road.
Just as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without actions is dead.
My brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers. You know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
We all make many mistakes. Anyone who never says anything wrong is perfect, and able to control their whole body too.
We put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, and we can turn their whole body.
Or think of ships. They are very big and are pushed by strong winds, yet a very small rudder steers them wherever the pilot wants to go.
In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts about great things. Think how a small flame can set a huge forest on fire!
The tongue is like a fire, a whole world of evil among the parts of our body. It spoils the whole person. It can set our whole life on fire, and it is set on fire by hell itself.
People can tame every kind of animal, bird, crawling creature and sea creature, and have tamed them.
But no one can tame the tongue. It is restless and evil, full of deadly poison.
With our tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people, who are made like God.
Praise and cursing come out of the same mouth. My brothers and sisters, this should not happen.
Can fresh water and bitter water flow from the same spring?
My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine grow figs? In the same way, a salty spring cannot give fresh water.
Who among you is wise and understanding? Show it by living a good life, and by doing good things with the humility that comes from wisdom.
But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, do not boast about it, and do not lie against the truth.
That kind of wisdom does not come from God above. It is earthly, it is not from the Spirit, and it comes from demons.
Where there is jealousy and selfishness, there is disorder and every kind of evil.

But the wisdom that comes from God is first of all pure. It also loves peace, and it is gentle and willing to listen. It is full of mercy and good actions. It treats everyone the same and is always honest.
Those who make peace plant seeds of peace, and they harvest a good and right life.
What causes fights and arguments among you? Do they not come from the selfish desires that battle inside you?
You want things, but you do not get them. So you kill and you are jealous, but you still cannot get what you want. So you argue and fight. You do not have what you want because you do not ask God.
And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask for the wrong reasons. You only want to spend it on your own pleasures.
You are unfaithful to God! Do you not know that being a friend of the world means being an enemy of God? Anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes God's enemy.
Do you think the Scripture means nothing when it says that the Spirit God put in us longs for us jealously?
But God gives us even more kindness. That is why the Scripture says, "God is against the proud, but he is kind to the humble."
So give yourselves to God. Stand against the devil, and he will run away from you.
Come close to God, and he will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners. Make your hearts pure, you who cannot decide between God and the world.
Be sad, cry and weep. Let your laughing turn into crying, and your joy into sadness.
Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

Brothers and sisters, do not speak against each other. Anyone who speaks against a brother or sister, or judges them, speaks against God's law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not obeying it. You are acting like its judge.
There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who can save and destroy. So who are you to judge your neighbour?
Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this city, stay there for a year, do business and make money."
You do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are like a mist that appears for a little while and then disappears.
Instead, you should say, "If the Lord wants us to, we will live and do this or that."
But now you are proud and boast. All boasting like that is evil.
So if anyone knows the good they should do and does not do it, they are sinning.
Now listen, you rich people. Cry and scream because of the troubles that are coming to you.
Your riches have rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
Your gold and silver have rusted. That rust will be a witness against you, and it will eat your bodies like fire. You have stored up treasure in these last days.

Listen! You cheated the workers who cut your fields and did not pay them. Their pay cries out against you. The cries of those who brought in your harvest have reached the ears of the Lord of Heaven's Armies.
You have lived on earth in luxury and pleasure. You have fattened yourselves like animals ready to be killed.
You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who were not fighting against you.
So be patient, brothers and sisters, until the Lord comes back. Think about the farmer, who waits patiently for his land to give a good crop. He waits for the autumn and spring rains.
You too must be patient and keep your hearts strong, because the Lord's coming is near.
Brothers and sisters, do not complain about each other, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!
Brothers and sisters, think of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They are an example of how to suffer patiently.
We call those who stayed strong blessed. You have heard how Job kept going, and you have seen how the Lord helped him in the end. The Lord is full of kindness and mercy.
Most of all, my brothers and sisters, do not make promises by swearing, not by heaven, not by the earth, and not by anything else. Just say a simple "yes" or "no", so that you will not be judged.
Is anyone among you in trouble? They should pray. Is anyone happy? They should sing songs of praise.
Is anyone among you sick? They should call the church leaders to pray over them, and pour oil on them in the name of the Lord.
A prayer made with faith will heal the sick person, and the Lord will make them well. If they have sinned, they will be forgiven.
So tell each other your sins and pray for each other, so that you will be healed. The prayer of a person who lives right with God is very powerful.
Elijah was a human being just like us. He prayed hard that it would not rain, and no rain fell on the land for three and a half years.
Then he prayed again, and the sky sent rain, and the earth grew its crops.
My brothers and sisters, if one of you wanders away from the truth, and someone brings them back,
remember this: whoever turns a sinner away from their wrong path will save them from death, and many sins will be forgiven.
1Pet: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's chosen people, who live as foreigners scattered through Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia.

God the Father knew you and chose you long ago. The Spirit has made you holy, so that you will obey Jesus Christ and be made clean by his blood. May God give you more and more of his kindness and peace.
Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! Because of his great mercy, he has given us new life. Jesus Christ rose from the dead, and so we have a living hope.
God has kept a gift for you in heaven that can never be destroyed, spoiled or fade away.
Through your faith, God's power protects you until the salvation that is ready to be shown at the end of time.
This makes you very glad, even though for a little while you may have to suffer many kinds of troubles.

These troubles test your faith, which is worth more than gold. Gold can be tested by fire, but it will not last. Your faith, proved true, will bring praise, glory and honour when Jesus Christ appears.
You have never seen him, yet you love him. You do not see him now, but you believe in him, and you are filled with a great joy, too glorious for words.
For you are receiving what your faith is aiming for: the salvation of your souls.
The prophets searched and studied very carefully about this salvation. They spoke about the kindness God would show to you.
The Spirit of Christ in them told them ahead of time about Christ's sufferings and the glory that would come after. They tried to find out who this would be, and when it would happen.

God showed them that their work was not for themselves, but for you. Now these things have been told to you by those who preached the good news with the help of the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even the angels long to look into these things.
So get your minds ready for action. Keep a clear head, and put all your hope in the kindness God will give you when Jesus Christ appears.
Be obedient children of God. Do not live by the wrong desires you followed when you did not know better.
Instead, be holy in everything you do, just as God who called you is holy.
For the Scriptures say, "Be holy, because I am holy."
You call God your Father, and he judges everyone fairly by what they have done. So live with deep respect for him while you are foreigners here on earth.
You know that God paid to set you free from the empty way of life you learned from your ancestors. He did not pay with silver or gold, which do not last.
He paid with the precious blood of Christ, who was like a perfect lamb without any fault.
God chose Christ before the world was made, but he has come in these last days for your sake.
Through Christ you believe in God, who raised him from death and gave him glory. So your faith and hope are in God.
You have made yourselves pure by obeying the truth, so now you truly love each other as brothers and sisters. So keep on loving each other deeply, with all your heart.
You have been given new life, not from a seed that dies, but from one that cannot die. You have been born again through God's word, which is alive and lasts forever.
As the Scripture says, "All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers in the field. The grass dries up and the flower falls,
but the word of the Lord lasts forever." And this word is the good news that was preached to you.
So get rid of all evil, all lying, pretending, jealousy and all unkind talk.
Like newborn babies, long for the pure milk of God's word, so that it can help you grow,
now that you have tasted how good the Lord is.
Come to Jesus. He is the living stone that people threw away, but God chose him as precious.
You also are like living stones, being built into a house where God's Spirit lives. You are a holy group of priests, offering spiritual sacrifices that please God through Jesus Christ.
For the Scripture says, "Look, I am placing a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone. Anyone who trusts in him will never be put to shame."
For you who believe, this stone is precious. But for those who do not believe, "The stone the builders rejected has become the most important stone."
And, "It is a stone that makes people trip, and a rock that makes them fall." They trip because they do not obey God's message, and that is what was planned for them.

But you are God's chosen people, royal priests, a holy nation, people who belong to God. He called you out of darkness into his wonderful light, so that you can tell others about the great things he has done.
Once you were not God's people, but now you are. Once you had not received mercy, but now you have received God's mercy.
Dear friends, you are like foreigners and visitors in this world. So I beg you, stay away from the wrong desires of the body, which fight against your soul.
Live such good lives among people who do not know God that, even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see the good things you do. Then they will praise God on the day he comes.
For the Lord's sake, obey every human authority: the king, who is the highest,
and the governors he sends to punish those who do wrong and to praise those who do right.
God wants you to do good, so that you will stop foolish people from saying ignorant things.
Live as free people, but do not use your freedom as an excuse to do evil. Live as God's servants.
Respect everyone. Love your fellow believers. Honour God. Respect the king.
Slaves, obey your masters with full respect, not only those who are good and kind, but also those who are cruel.
God is pleased when you put up with pain, suffering for something you did not deserve, because you are thinking of God.
What credit is there if you are beaten for doing wrong and you put up with it? But if you suffer for doing good and you put up with it, God is pleased with you.
God called you to this, because Christ also suffered for you. He left you an example, so that you would follow in his footsteps.
"He never sinned, and he never told a lie."
When people insulted him, he did not insult them back. When he suffered, he did not threaten anyone. He trusted himself to God, who judges fairly.
He himself carried our sins in his body on the cross, so that we would die to sin and live for what is right. You have been healed by his wounds.
You were like sheep that wandered away, but now you have come back to the Shepherd who takes care of your souls.
In the same way, wives, accept the authority of your husbands. Then, if some of them do not obey God's word, they may be won over without words by the way you live,
when they see your pure lives and your respect for God.
Do not make your beauty depend on outward things like fancy hairstyles, gold jewellery or fine clothes.
Instead, let your beauty come from inside, from your heart. A gentle and quiet spirit is a beauty that never fades, and it is very precious to God.
This is how the holy women of long ago, who put their hope in God, made themselves beautiful. They accepted the authority of their husbands,
like Sarah, who obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her daughters if you do what is right and do not let anything make you afraid.

In the same way, husbands, live with your wives with understanding. Treat them with honour, because they may be weaker than you, and they share with you in the gift of new life from God. Do this so that nothing will stop your prayers.
Finally, all of you should agree with each other and feel for each other. Love each other as brothers and sisters. Be kind and humble.
Do not pay back evil with evil, or insult with insult. Instead, bless those people, because God called you to do this, so that you will receive his blessing.
As the Scripture says, "Whoever wants to love life and see good days must keep their tongue from evil and their lips from telling lies.
They must turn away from evil and do good. They must look for peace and work hard to keep it.
The Lord's eyes watch over those who do what is right, and his ears listen to their prayers. But the Lord turns his face against those who do evil."
Who will hurt you if you are eager to do good?
But even if you suffer for doing what is right, you are blessed. "Do not be afraid of what they fear, and do not be worried."
Instead, honour Christ as Lord in your hearts. Always be ready to explain to anyone who asks why you have hope. But do it gently and with respect.
Keep your conscience clear. Then, when people speak against you, those who insult your good life in Christ will be ashamed.
If God wants you to suffer, it is better to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
Christ suffered for sins once for all time, a good person for those who are bad, to bring you to God. His body was put to death, but he was made alive by the Spirit.
In the Spirit he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
who disobeyed God long ago, when God waited patiently while Noah built the big boat. Only a few people, eight in all, were saved through the water.

That water is a picture of baptism, which now saves you. Baptism is not about washing dirt off your body. It is asking God for a clear conscience. It saves you through Jesus Christ rising from the dead.
Now Jesus has gone into heaven and is at God's right hand. Angels, rulers and powers all obey him.
Christ suffered in his body, so you also must be ready to suffer, with the same attitude he had. Anyone who has suffered in their body is finished with sin.
So they no longer live the rest of their life on earth for wrong human desires, but for what God wants.

You have already spent enough time in the past doing what people who do not know God like to do. You lived in sexual sin and wrong desires, getting drunk, wild parties, drinking and worshipping idols, which God hates.
Now those people think it is strange that you no longer join them in their wild living, and they insult you.
But they will have to explain themselves to God, who is ready to judge the living and the dead.
That is why the good news was preached even to those who are now dead. They were judged in their bodies like all people, but they can live in the spirit, as God lives.
The end of all things is near. So think clearly and control yourselves, so that you can pray.
Most of all, love each other deeply, because love covers over many sins.
Welcome each other into your homes without complaining.
God has given each of you a gift. Use it to serve each other, taking good care of all the different ways God shows his kindness.

If anyone speaks, they should speak as if they are speaking God's very words. If anyone serves, they should serve with the strength God gives. Then God will be praised in everything through Jesus Christ. Glory and power belong to him forever and ever. Amen.
Dear friends, do not be surprised by the fiery troubles that have come to test you, as if something strange were happening to you.
Instead, be glad that you share in Christ's sufferings, so that you will be full of joy when his glory is shown.
If people insult you because you follow Christ, you are blessed, because the glorious Spirit of God rests on you. They speak evil of him, but you bring him glory.
None of you should suffer for being a murderer, a thief or someone who does evil, or for poking into other people's business.
But if you suffer for being a Christian, do not be ashamed. Praise God that you carry that name.
The time has come for judgment to begin with God's own family. And if it begins with us, what will happen to those who do not obey God's good news?
As the Scripture says, "If it is hard for good people to be saved, what will happen to those who do not care about God, and to sinners?"
So if you suffer because God allows it, keep doing good, and trust yourselves to God. He made you, and he will always be faithful.
Now I have something to say to the church leaders among you. I am a leader too, and I saw Christ suffer with my own eyes. I will also share in the glory that will be shown. I beg you:

take care of God's flock, the people in your care, like shepherds. Watch over them, not because you have to, but because you want to, as God wants. Do not do it to get money, but because you are eager to serve.
Do not boss around the people in your care, but be good examples to them.
When Christ, the Chief Shepherd, appears, you will receive a crown of glory that will never fade away.
In the same way, you younger people should accept the authority of the leaders. All of you, be humble with each other, because "God is against the proud, but he is kind to the humble."
So humble yourselves under God's mighty hand, and at the right time he will lift you up.
Give all your worries to him, because he cares about you.
Keep a clear head and control yourselves. Stay alert! Your enemy the devil walks around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to eat.
Stand against him, and stay strong in your faith. Remember that your brothers and sisters all over the world are going through the same kind of suffering.

You will suffer for a little while. But after that, God, who is full of kindness and who called you to share his glory forever in Christ Jesus, will make you complete and strong. He will hold you up and keep you steady.
All power belongs to him forever and ever. Amen.
I have written this short letter with the help of Silas, who I know is a faithful brother. I want to encourage you and tell you that this is the true kindness of God. Stand firm in it.
The church here in Babylon, chosen by God just like you, sends you greetings. So does my son Mark.
Greet each other with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who belong to Christ. Amen.
2Pet: From Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ. To those who have received a faith as precious as ours, because our God and Saviour Jesus Christ is fair and good.
May God give you more and more of his kindness and peace, as you come to know God and Jesus our Lord.
By his divine power, God has given us everything we need to live a life that pleases him. We have it because we know Jesus, who called us by his own glory and goodness.
Through these he has given us his precious and very great promises. By them you can share in God's own nature, and escape from the rot in the world that comes from wrong desires.
For this very reason, try your hardest to add goodness to your faith. To goodness add knowledge.
To knowledge add self-control. To self-control add patience. To patience add a life that honours God.
To that add kindness to your brothers and sisters, and to kindness add love.
If you have these things, and they keep growing, they will stop you from being lazy or useless in knowing our Lord Jesus Christ.
Anyone who does not have them is short-sighted and blind. They have forgotten that their old sins were washed away.
So, brothers and sisters, work even harder to make sure God really has called and chosen you. If you do these things, you will never fall.
And you will be warmly welcomed into the kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, which lasts forever.
So I will always remind you about these things, even though you already know them and are standing firm in the truth you have.
I think it is right to keep reminding you, as long as I live in this tent, my body.
I know that I will soon leave this tent, as our Lord Jesus Christ has shown me.
I will do my best to make sure that you can always remember these things after I am gone.
When we told you about the power of our Lord Jesus Christ and his coming, we were not following clever made-up stories. We saw his greatness with our own eyes.
God the Father gave him honour and glory. The voice came to him from God's great glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love. I am very pleased with him."
We heard this voice come from heaven while we were with him on the holy mountain.
So we are even more sure of the message the prophets gave. You should pay attention to it, like a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day begins and the morning star rises in your hearts.
Most of all, you must understand this: no prophecy in the Scriptures came from the prophet's own ideas.
No prophecy ever came because a person wanted it. Prophets were people who spoke from God, as the Holy Spirit moved them.

But there were also false prophets among God's people long ago, and there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly bring in teachings that destroy people. They will even reject the Master who paid to set them free, and they will quickly bring destruction on themselves.
Many people will follow their sexual sins, and because of them, people will speak badly about the way of truth.
Because they are greedy, these teachers will use made-up stories to take money from you. But God's judgment on them was decided long ago, and it is not asleep. Their destruction is coming.
God did not spare the angels who sinned. He threw them down to the deepest pit, and put them in chains of darkness, to be kept there until the judgment.
He did not spare the ancient world, but he sent a flood on the people who did not care about him. Yet he protected Noah, who preached about doing right, and seven others with him.
God condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and burned them to ashes. He made them an example of what will happen to people who do not care about him.
But he rescued Lot, a good man, who was very upset by the shameful lives of those evil people.
That good man lived among them, and day after day the evil things he saw and heard hurt his good heart.
So the Lord knows how to rescue those who honour him from their troubles. And he knows how to keep evil people under punishment until the day of judgment.
This is especially true of those who follow the dirty desires of their bodies and look down on authority. They are proud and stubborn, and they are not afraid to insult glorious beings in heaven.
Even angels, who are much stronger and more powerful, do not bring insulting charges against such beings before the Lord.
But these people are like animals without reason, born only to be caught and killed. They insult what they do not understand, and they will be destroyed like animals.

They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. They enjoy wild partying in broad daylight. They are like dirty spots and stains among you, enjoying their tricks while they eat with you.
Their eyes are always looking for someone to sleep with, and they never stop sinning. They trap people who are weak in faith. Their hearts are trained in greed. They are under God's curse!
They have left the right road and wandered off. They followed the way of Balaam son of Beor, who loved the money he could get by doing wrong.
But Balaam was told off for his wrong. A donkey, which cannot talk, spoke with a human voice and stopped the prophet's madness.
These people are like springs with no water, and like clouds blown by a storm. The deepest darkness is waiting for them forever.
They boast with big, empty words. They use sexual desires to trap people who have only just escaped from those who live wrong lives.
They promise them freedom, but they themselves are slaves to what destroys them. People are slaves to whatever controls them.
They had escaped the dirt of the world by knowing our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. If they get caught up in it again and are beaten by it, they end up worse than they were at the beginning.
It would have been better for them never to have known the right way, than to know it and then turn away from the holy command they were given.
What happened to them shows that these true sayings are right: "A dog goes back to its vomit," and "A pig that is washed goes back to roll in the mud."
Dear friends, this is now the second letter I have written to you. In both letters I have tried to get you thinking clearly by reminding you of things.
I want you to remember the words the holy prophets spoke long ago, and the command that our Lord and Saviour gave through your apostles.
First of all, you must understand that in the last days people will come who laugh at the truth and follow their own wrong desires.
They will say, "Jesus promised to come back. So where is he? Since our ancestors died, everything has carried on just as it has since the world was made."
But they choose to forget that long ago God made the heavens by his word. He formed the earth out of water and with water.
Then he used water to flood and destroy that world.
By the same word, the heavens and the earth that exist now are being kept for fire. They are being kept for the day when God will judge and destroy people who do not care about him.
Dear friends, do not forget this one thing: to the Lord, one day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like one day.
The Lord is not slow to keep his promise, as some people think. Instead, he is being patient with you. He does not want anyone to be destroyed. He wants everyone to turn away from their sins.

But the day of the Lord will come as suddenly as a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud roar. Everything in them will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done on it will be burned up.
Since everything will be destroyed like this, what kind of people should you be? You should live holy lives that honour God,
as you wait for the day of God and work to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything in them will melt in the heat.
But we are waiting for what God promised: new heavens and a new earth, where everything is right and good.
So, dear friends, while you are waiting for this, try your hardest to be at peace with God, and to be pure and without fault in his eyes.
Remember that our Lord is patient so that people can be saved. Our dear brother Paul wrote to you about this too, with the wisdom God gave him.

He writes about these things in all his letters. Some things in them are hard to understand. People who do not know better and whose faith is weak twist their meaning, just as they twist the other Scriptures. In the end, they destroy themselves.
Dear friends, you already know these things. So be careful, so that you are not led away by the mistakes of evil people and lose your firm footing.
But grow in the kindness and knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. Glory to him, now and forever! Amen.
1John: We write to you about the Word of life, who was there from the beginning. We have heard him, we have seen him with our own eyes, we looked at him, and our hands touched him.
This life was shown to us. We have seen it, and we tell you about it. We announce to you the life that lasts forever, which was with the Father and was shown to us.
We tell you what we have seen and heard, so that you can share in this life with us. And our sharing is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
We write these things to you so that our joy can be full.
This is the message we heard from him and now tell you: God is light, and there is no darkness in him at all.
If we say that we share life with him, but we keep walking in darkness, we are lying and we are not living the truth.
But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we share life with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.
If we say that we have no sin, we fool ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and fair. He will forgive our sins and make us clean from all the wrong we have done.
If we say that we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his word is not in us.
My little children, I write these things to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have someone who speaks to the Father for us, Jesus Christ, the one who is right.
He is the sacrifice that takes away our sins. And not only our sins, but the sins of the whole world.
This is how we know that we know him: if we obey his commands.
Anyone who says, "I know him," but does not obey his commands, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
But whoever obeys his word, God's love has truly become complete in that person. This is how we know that we are in him:
anyone who says he lives in him must live the way Jesus lived.
Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command. It is an old command that you have had from the beginning. This old command is the message you have already heard.
And yet I am writing you a new command. Its truth is seen in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.
Anyone who says he is in the light but hates his brother is still in the darkness, even now.
Anyone who loves his brother lives in the light, and there is nothing in him to make him fall.
But anyone who hates his brother is in the darkness. He walks in the darkness and does not know where he is going, because the darkness has made him blind.
I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven because of the name of Jesus.

I write to you, fathers, because you know him who has been there from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have won the fight against the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who has been there from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, the word of God lives in you, and you have won the fight against the evil one.
Do not love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
Everything in the world, the wrong desires of the body, the greedy desires of the eyes, and the proud showing off of what we have, does not come from the Father. It comes from the world.
The world and its wrong desires are passing away, but whoever does what God wants will live forever.
Little children, this is the last hour. You heard that the Antichrist is coming, and even now many antichrists have come. That is how we know that it is the last hour.
They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. If they had belonged to us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, and that showed that none of them belonged to us.
But you have been anointed by the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.
I am not writing to you because you do not know the truth. I write because you do know it, and because no lie comes from the truth.
Who is the liar? It is the one who says that Jesus is not the Christ. That person is the Antichrist, the one who rejects both the Father and the Son.
Anyone who rejects the Son does not have the Father. Anyone who confesses the Son has the Father too.
So make sure that what you heard from the beginning stays in you. If what you heard from the beginning stays in you, you will also stay in the Son and in the Father.
And this is what he promised us: life that lasts forever.
I am writing these things to you about the people who are trying to lead you the wrong way.

But as for you, the anointing you received from him stays in you, so you do not need anyone to teach you. His anointing teaches you about everything, and it is true, not a lie. So stay in him, just as it has taught you.
And now, little children, stay in him. Then when he appears, we can be bold and not be ashamed in front of him when he comes.
If you know that he is right and good, you also know that everyone who does what is right has been born of him.
See how great a love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God! And that is what we are. The world does not know us, because it did not know him.
Dear friends, we are children of God now. What we will be has not yet been shown. But we know that when he appears, we will be like him, because we will see him as he really is.
Everyone who has this hope in him keeps himself pure, just as Jesus is pure.
Everyone who sins breaks God's law. Sin is breaking God's law.
You know that Jesus came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in him.
Anyone who lives in him does not keep on sinning. Anyone who keeps on sinning has not seen him and does not know him.
Little children, do not let anyone lead you the wrong way. Anyone who does what is right is right with God, just as Jesus is right.
Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The Son of God came for this reason: to destroy the work of the devil.
Anyone who is born of God does not keep on sinning, because God's seed lives in him. He cannot keep on sinning, because he has been born of God.
This is how we can tell who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are. Anyone who does not do what is right is not from God, and neither is anyone who does not love his brother.
This is the message you heard from the beginning: we should love one another.
Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because the things he did were evil, and the things his brother did were right.
My brothers, do not be surprised if the world hates you.
We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers. Anyone who does not love his brother still lives in death.
Anyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has life that lasts forever living in him.
This is how we know what love is: Jesus gave his life for us. So we should also give our lives for our brothers.
If anyone has enough to live on and sees his brother in need, but closes his heart against him, how can God's love be in him?
My little children, let us not love only with words or talk, but with what we do and in truth.
This is how we will know that we belong to the truth, and how we can calm our hearts in front of him:
even if our heart blames us, God is greater than our heart, and he knows everything.
Dear friends, if our heart does not blame us, we can come to God boldly.
And we receive from him whatever we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.
This is his command: that we believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, just as he commanded us.
Anyone who obeys his commands lives in God, and God lives in him. And this is how we know that he lives in us: by the Spirit he has given us.
Dear friends, do not believe every spirit. Test the spirits to see whether they come from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.
This is how you can know the Spirit of God: every spirit that says Jesus Christ came as a real human being is from God.
But every spirit that does not say this about Jesus is not from God. That is the spirit of the Antichrist. You heard that it was coming, and now it is already in the world.
Little children, you belong to God, and you have won against them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
They belong to the world. So they speak the way the world speaks, and the world listens to them.
We belong to God. Anyone who knows God listens to us. Anyone who is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we can tell the spirit of truth from the spirit of lies.
Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.
Anyone who does not love does not know God, because God is love.
This is how God showed his love among us: he sent his only Son into the world so that we could have life through him.
This is what love is: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as the sacrifice that takes away our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we should also love one another.
No one has ever seen God. But if we love one another, God lives in us, and his love is made complete in us.
This is how we know that we live in him and he lives in us: he has given us his Spirit.
We have seen, and we tell others, that the Father sent his Son to be the Saviour of the world.
If anyone says that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him, and he lives in God.
We know the love God has for us, and we believe it. God is love. Anyone who lives in love lives in God, and God lives in him.
This is how love is made complete among us, so that we can be bold on the day God judges. For in this world we are like Jesus.
There is no fear in love. Perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. Anyone who is afraid has not been made perfect in love.
We love him, because he loved us first.
If anyone says, "I love God," but hates his brother, he is a liar. If he does not love his brother, whom he has seen, he cannot love God, whom he has not seen.
And he has given us this command: anyone who loves God must also love his brother.
Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. And everyone who loves the Father also loves the child born of him.
This is how we know that we love God's children: when we love God and obey his commands.
Loving God means obeying his commands. And his commands are not too hard for us.
Everyone born of God wins against the world. And this is the victory that has won against the world: our faith.
Who can win against the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
Jesus Christ is the one who came by water and blood. He came not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. And the Spirit tells us this is true, because the Spirit is the truth.
So there are three that tell us about him:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. And the three agree as one.
We accept what people tell us, but what God tells us is greater. And this is what God has said about his Son.
Anyone who believes in the Son of God has God's witness in his heart. Anyone who does not believe God has made God a liar, because he has not believed what God has said about his Son.
And this is what God has said: God has given us life that lasts forever, and this life is in his Son.
Anyone who has the Son has life. Anyone who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you can know that you have life that lasts forever, and so that you keep believing in the name of the Son of God.
This is how bold we can be when we come to God: if we ask for anything that is what he wants, he listens to us.
And if we know that he listens to us whatever we ask, we know that we already have what we asked him for.

If anyone sees his brother doing a sin that does not lead to death, he should pray, and God will give that person life. I mean those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying he should pray about that.
All wrongdoing is sin, but there is sin that does not lead to death.
We know that anyone born of God does not keep on sinning. The Son who was born of God keeps him safe, and the evil one cannot touch him.
We know that we belong to God, and that the whole world is under the power of the evil one.

We know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we can know the one who is true. And we are in the one who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and life that lasts forever.
Little children, keep yourselves away from idols.
2John: From the elder, to the chosen lady and her children. I truly love you, and not only I, but also everyone who knows the truth loves you.
We love you because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever.
Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, will be with us in truth and love.
I was very glad to find some of your children living in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
And now, dear lady, I ask you that we love one another. This is not a new command I am writing to you. It is the one we have had from the beginning.
And this is love: that we live by obeying his commands. This is the command you heard from the beginning: that you live in love.
Many liars have gone out into the world. They do not say that Jesus Christ came as a real human being. Anyone like that is the liar and the Antichrist.
Watch out, so that you do not lose what we have worked for, but receive your full reward.
Anyone who goes too far and does not stay in the teaching of Christ does not have God. Anyone who stays in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house, and do not welcome him.
Anyone who welcomes him takes part in the evil things he does.
I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to use paper and ink. I hope to come to you and talk face to face, so that our joy can be full.
The children of your chosen sister send you their greetings. Amen.
3John: From the elder, to my dear friend Gaius, whom I truly love.
Dear friend, I pray that everything goes well for you and that you are healthy, just as your soul is doing well.
I was very glad when some brothers came and told me about your faithfulness to the truth, and how you live in the truth.
Nothing gives me greater joy than to hear that my children are living in the truth.
Dear friend, you are being faithful in what you do for the brothers, even though they are strangers to you.
They have told the church about your love. Please help them on their journey in a way that honours God.
They went out for the sake of the Name of Jesus, and they took nothing from people who do not believe.
So we should welcome people like them, so that we work together for the truth.
I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the most important among them, does not accept what we say.

So if I come, I will point out what he is doing. He says evil and untrue things about us. And that is not enough for him. He also refuses to welcome the brothers, and he stops those who want to welcome them, and throws them out of the church.
Dear friend, do not copy what is evil, but copy what is good. Anyone who does good is from God. Anyone who does evil has not seen God.
Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that what we say is true.
I have many things to write to you, but I do not want to use pen and ink.
I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face. Peace be with you. The friends here send their greetings. Greet each of the friends there by name.
Jude: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James. To those who are called, who are loved and made holy by God the Father, and kept safe for Jesus Christ:
May you have more and more mercy, peace, and love.
Dear friends, I really wanted to write to you about the salvation we all share. But I felt I had to write and urge you to fight hard for the faith that God gave to his holy people once and for all.

Some people have sneaked in among you without being noticed. Long ago it was written that they would be judged. They are ungodly people. They turn the grace of our God into an excuse for shameful living, and they reject Jesus Christ, our only Master and Lord.
You already know all this, but I want to remind you. The Lord saved his people out of the land of Egypt, but later he destroyed those who did not believe.
And there were angels who did not stay in their place of power, but left their own home. God has kept them in chains that last forever, in darkness, waiting for the judgment on the great day.

In the same way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them gave themselves to sexual sin and chased unnatural desires. They are shown as an example of those who suffer the punishment of fire that lasts forever.
In the same way, these people follow their dreams. They make their bodies dirty with sin, reject authority, and say evil things about heavenly beings.
But even Michael, the chief angel, when he was arguing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare to accuse him with insulting words. He only said, "May the Lord rebuke you!"
But these people speak evil of things they do not understand. And the things they do understand by instinct, like animals without reason, are the very things that destroy them.
How terrible it will be for them! They have followed the way of Cain. They have rushed into Balaam's mistake for money. And they have been destroyed like Korah in his rebellion.

These people are like hidden rocks at your love feasts, where they eat with you without shame. They are shepherds who only feed themselves. They are clouds without water, blown along by the wind. They are trees in autumn without fruit, dead twice over, pulled up by the roots.
They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their own shame. They are wandering stars, and the deepest darkness has been kept for them forever.
Enoch, who lived seven generations after Adam, spoke as a prophet about these people. He said, "Look, the Lord is coming with many thousands of his holy ones,

to judge everyone, and to show all the ungodly people how wrong they are. He will judge them for all the ungodly things they have done in ungodly ways, and for all the harsh words ungodly sinners have spoken against him."
These people grumble and complain. They follow their own wrong desires. They boast about themselves, and they flatter others to get what they want.
But you, dear friends, remember the words spoken earlier by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
They told you, "In the last times there will be people who mock, and who follow their own ungodly desires."
These are the people who divide you. They follow their natural desires and do not have the Spirit.
But you, dear friends, keep building yourselves up in your most holy faith, and pray in the Holy Spirit.
Keep yourselves in God's love, as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to life that lasts forever.
Be kind to those who have doubts.
Save others by pulling them out of the fire. Show mercy to others, but be careful, and hate even the clothes that are stained by sin.
Now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to bring you without fault and with great joy into his glorious presence,
to the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, be glory, greatness, power, and authority, before all time, now, and forever. Amen.
Rev: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ. God gave it to him to show his servants what must happen soon. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John.
John tells about everything he saw. He tells the word of God and what Jesus Christ said was true.
Blessed is the one who reads the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and keep what is written in it, because the time is near.
From John, to the seven churches in Asia: Grace and peace to you from God, who is, who was, and who is to come, and from the seven Spirits in front of his throne,
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and has set us free from our sins by his blood,
and has made us a Kingdom, priests to serve his God and Father, to him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
Look, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, even those who pierced him. All the peoples of the earth will cry because of him. Yes, it will be so! Amen.
"I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end," says the Lord God, "who is, who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."

I, John, am your brother. I share with you in the suffering, the Kingdom, and the patient endurance we have in Jesus. I was on the island called Patmos because I preached God's word and told about Jesus.
On the Lord's day I was in the Spirit, and I heard a loud voice behind me, like a trumpet.
It said, "Write in a book what you see, and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."
I turned around to see who was speaking to me. And when I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.
Among the lampstands was someone like a son of man. He was wearing a long robe down to his feet, with a golden belt around his chest.
His head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow. His eyes were like flames of fire.
His feet were like shining bronze glowing in a furnace. His voice sounded like the roar of rushing waters.
In his right hand he held seven stars. Out of his mouth came a sharp sword with two edges. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet as if I were dead. Then he put his right hand on me and said, "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,
and the Living One. I was dead, but look, I am alive forever and ever! Amen. And I hold the keys of Death and of Hades.
So write down what you have seen, what is now, and what will happen after this.

This is the secret meaning of the seven stars you saw in my right hand, and of the seven golden lampstands: The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."
"Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: This is what the one says who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:
I know what you do, how hard you work, and how you keep going. I know you cannot stand evil people. You have tested those who call themselves apostles but are not, and you found out they are liars.
You have kept going and have suffered for my name, and you have not given up.
But I have this against you: you have left the love you had at first.
So remember how far you have fallen. Turn back to God, and do the things you did at first. If you do not turn back, I will come to you and take your lampstand away from its place.
But you have this in your favour: you hate what the Nicolaitans do, which I also hate.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins the victory, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.
Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: This is what the one says who is the First and the Last, who died and came back to life:
I know your suffering and your poverty, but you are rich! I know the evil things said against you by those who say they are Jews but are not. They are a synagogue of Satan.

Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. Look, the devil will throw some of you into prison to test you, and you will suffer for ten days. Be faithful, even if it means death, and I will give you the crown of life.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death.
Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: This is what the one says who has the sharp sword with two edges:
I know where you live, where Satan has his throne. Yet you hold on to my name. You did not give up your faith in me, even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was killed among you, where Satan lives.
But I have a few things against you. Some of you follow the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to make the people of Israel fall into sin. They ate food offered to idols and did sexual sin.
In the same way, some of you also follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So turn back to God! If you do not, I will come to you soon and fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone with a new name written on it, a name no one knows except the one who receives it.
Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: This is what the Son of God says, whose eyes are like flames of fire and whose feet are like shining bronze:
I know what you do: your love, your faith, your service, and how you keep going. And I know that you are doing more now than you did at first.
But I have this against you: you allow that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. By her teaching she leads my servants into sexual sin and into eating food offered to idols.
I gave her time to turn away from her sexual sin, but she does not want to.
So I will throw her onto a bed of suffering. And those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly, unless they turn away from what she does.
I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am the one who looks deep into minds and hearts. I will pay back each of you for what you have done.
Now I speak to the rest of you in Thyatira, who do not follow her teaching and have not learned what some call 'the deep secrets of Satan.' I will not put any other load on you.
Only hold on tightly to what you have until I come.
To the one who wins the victory and keeps doing what I want until the end, I will give power over the nations.
He will rule them with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots, just as I have received power from my Father.
I will also give him the morning star.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
"Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: This is what the one says who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know what you do. People say you are alive, but you are dead.
Wake up! Make strong what is left, before it dies too. I have found that what you do is not complete in the eyes of my God.
So remember what you received and heard. Obey it, and turn back to God. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what hour I will come to you.
But there are a few people in Sardis who have not made their clothes dirty. They will walk with me dressed in white, because they are worthy.
The one who wins the victory will be dressed in white like them. I will never erase his name from the book of life. I will say his name before my Father and his angels.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: This is what the one says who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens, no one can shut, and what he shuts, no one can open.
I know what you do. Look, I have put an open door in front of you that no one can shut. I know you have only a little strength, yet you have kept my word and have not denied my name.
Look, there are some from the synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews but are not. They are lying. I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I have loved you.
You have obeyed my command to keep going patiently. So I will keep you safe from the time of testing that is coming on the whole world, to test the people who live on the earth.
I am coming soon! Hold on to what you have, so that no one takes your crown.

I will make the one who wins the victory a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will never leave it again. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from my God. I will also write on him my own new name.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: This is what the Amen says, the faithful and true witness, the source of God's creation:
I know what you do. You are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were either cold or hot!
But because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold, I am about to spit you out of my mouth.
You say, 'I am rich. I have become wealthy and I do not need anything.' But you do not know that you are miserable, pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.

So I advise you to buy from me gold made pure in fire, so that you can be truly rich. Buy white clothes to wear, so that your shameful nakedness is covered. And buy medicine to put on your eyes, so that you can see.
I correct and discipline everyone I love. So be serious, and turn back to God.
Look! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in and eat with him, and he with me.
To the one who wins the victory, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Anyone who has ears should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

After this I looked, and I saw a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had heard before, which sounded like a trumpet, said to me, "Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this."
Right away I was in the Spirit. And there in heaven was a throne, with someone sitting on it.
The one sitting there shone like jasper and red carnelian stones. A rainbow that looked like an emerald was around the throne.
Around the throne were twenty-four other thrones. On them sat twenty-four elders, dressed in white clothes, with gold crowns on their heads.
Flashes of lightning, loud sounds, and thunder came from the throne. In front of the throne seven lamps of fire were burning. These are the seven Spirits of God.
Also in front of the throne there was something like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the middle, around the throne, were four living creatures, covered with eyes in front and behind.
The first living creature was like a lion. The second was like an ox. The third had a face like a man. The fourth was like a flying eagle.

Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around and inside. Day and night they never stop saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, who is, and who is to come!"
Whenever the living creatures give glory, honour, and thanks to the one who sits on the throne and lives forever and ever,
the twenty-four elders fall down in front of the one who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever. They lay their crowns in front of the throne and say:
"You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory, honour, and power, because you created all things. Because you wanted it, they were created and they exist!"
Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one sitting on the throne. It had writing on both sides and was sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a mighty angel calling out in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"
But no one in heaven, or on earth, or under the earth, could open the scroll or even look inside it.
I cried and cried, because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not cry! Look, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won the victory. He can open the scroll and its seven seals."

Then I saw a Lamb standing in the middle of the throne, with the four living creatures and the elders around him. He looked as if he had been killed. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God sent out into all the earth.
He came and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.
When he took it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down in front of the Lamb. Each one had a harp and gold bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of God's holy people.
And they sang a new song: "You are worthy to take the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed, and with your blood you bought people for God from every tribe, language, people, and nation.
You have made them a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will rule on the earth."
Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders. There were thousands and thousands of them, and ten thousand times ten thousand.
They sang with a loud voice: "Worthy is the Lamb who was killed, to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honour, glory, and praise!"

Then I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and in the sea, and everything in them, singing: "To the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise, honour, glory, and power, forever and ever! Amen!"
The four living creatures said, "Amen!" And the elders fell down and worshipped.
Then I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come and see!"
I looked, and there was a white horse. Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown. He rode out as a winner, to win more battles.
When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
Then another horse came out, a red one. Its rider was given power to take peace away from the earth, so that people would kill one another. He was given a large sword.
When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come and see!" I looked, and there was a black horse. Its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.

Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures. It said, "A small measure of wheat for a whole day's pay, and three small measures of barley for a whole day's pay! But do not harm the oil and the wine!"
When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come and see!"

I looked, and there was a pale horse. Its rider was named Death, and Hades followed close behind him. They were given power over a fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with hunger, with disease, and with the wild animals of the earth.
When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed because of God's word and because they told about the Lamb.
They cried out in a loud voice, "Holy and true Master, how long until you judge the people who live on the earth and pay them back for our blood?"
Then each of them was given a white robe. They were told to rest a little longer, until the full number of their fellow servants, their brothers and sisters, had been killed just as they had been.
I watched as the Lamb opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like rough black cloth, and the whole moon turned red like blood.
The stars in the sky fell to the earth, like unripe figs falling from a fig tree when a strong wind shakes it.
The sky rolled up like a scroll and disappeared. Every mountain and island was moved from its place.
Then the kings of the earth, the rulers, the army leaders, the rich, the powerful, and every slave and every free person hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us! Hide us from the face of the one who sits on the throne, and from the anger of the Lamb!
For the great day of their anger has come, and who can stand against it?"
After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. They were holding back the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the land, on the sea, or on any tree.
Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, carrying the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea.
He said, "Do not harm the land, the sea, or the trees until we have put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God!"
Then I heard how many were sealed: one hundred and forty-four thousand, from all the tribes of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, from the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, from the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, from the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, from the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, from the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,
from the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, from the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and from the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
