After this I looked, and there was a huge crowd that no one could count. They came from every nation, tribe, people, and language. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb, dressed in white robes, holding palm branches in their hands.
They shouted with a loud voice, "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!"
All the angels were standing around the throne, and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell on their faces in front of the throne and worshipped God.
They said, "Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honour, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen."
Then one of the elders asked me, "These people dressed in white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?"
I answered, "Sir, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones who have come out of the great suffering. They have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
That is why they are in front of the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple. And the one who sits on the throne will cover them with his presence.
They will never be hungry again, and never be thirsty again. The sun will not burn them, nor any heat.
For the Lamb in the middle of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to springs of living water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
Then I saw the seven angels who stand in front of God, and they were given seven trumpets.

Another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a gold pan for burning incense. He was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of all God's holy people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the angel's hand.
Then the angel took the pan, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down on the earth. There came thunder, loud sounds, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

The first angel blew his trumpet. Hail and fire mixed with blood came down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.
The second angel blew his trumpet. Something like a huge mountain on fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet. A great star, burning like a torch, fell from the sky. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became bitter, and many people died from drinking the water, because it had become bitter.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet. A third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them became dark. A third of the day had no light, and also a third of the night.

As I watched, I heard an eagle flying high in the sky, calling out in a loud voice: "How terrible! How terrible! How terrible for the people who live on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts the other three angels are about to blow!"
The fifth angel blew his trumpet. I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.
He opened the shaft of the bottomless pit, and smoke rose out of it like smoke from a huge furnace. The sun and the sky were darkened by the smoke from the pit.
Out of the smoke came locusts onto the earth. They were given power to sting like scorpions on the earth.
They were told not to harm the grass of the earth, or any green plant, or any tree. They could only harm the people who did not have God's seal on their foreheads.
They were not allowed to kill those people, only to cause them pain for five months. The pain was like the pain of a scorpion sting.
In those days people will look for death but will not find it. They will want to die, but death will run away from them.
The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and their faces looked like human faces.
Their hair was like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.
Their chests were covered with something like iron armour. The sound of their wings was like the roar of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
They had tails with stings like scorpions. In their tails they had power to hurt people for five months.
Their king was the angel of the bottomless pit. In Hebrew his name is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon, which means Destroyer.
The first terrible thing is past. Look, two more terrible things are still coming.
The sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice coming from the horns of the gold altar in front of God.
It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Set free the four angels who are tied up at the great river Euphrates!"
So the four angels were set free. They had been kept ready for this very hour, day, month, and year, to kill a third of all people.
I heard how many soldiers on horses there were: two hundred million.

In my vision I saw the horses and their riders. The riders wore armour that was fiery red, dark blue, and yellow like sulphur. The horses had heads like lions' heads, and fire, smoke, and sulphur came out of their mouths.
A third of all people were killed by these three disasters: the fire, the smoke, and the sulphur that came out of the horses' mouths.
The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes, with heads that they used to hurt people.

The rest of the people, who were not killed by these disasters, still did not turn away from the things they had made with their own hands. They did not stop worshipping demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, idols that cannot see, hear, or walk.
They also did not turn away from their murders, their witchcraft, their sexual sin, or their stealing.
Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was wrapped in a cloud, and there was a rainbow over his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
He was holding a little scroll that was open in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
He shouted with a loud voice, like a lion roaring. When he shouted, the seven thunders spoke with their voices.
When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write it down. But I heard a voice from heaven say, "Keep secret what the seven thunders said, and do not write it down."
Then the angel I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

He made a promise in the name of the one who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and everything in it, the earth and everything in it, and the sea and everything in it. He said, "There will be no more waiting!
When the seventh angel is about to blow his trumpet, God's secret plan will be completed, just as he told his servants the prophets."
Then the voice I had heard from heaven spoke to me again. It said, "Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."
So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will taste as sweet as honey."
I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it. In my mouth it tasted as sweet as honey, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned bitter.
Then I was told, "You must speak as a prophet again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."
Then I was given a measuring stick like a rod, and I was told, "Get up and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the people who worship there.
But leave out the outer courtyard of the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given to the nations. They will trample on the holy city for forty-two months.
And I will give power to my two witnesses. They will speak as prophets for one thousand two hundred and sixty days, dressed in rough cloth."
These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in front of the Lord of the earth.
If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes out of their mouths and burns up their enemies. Anyone who wants to harm them must die in this way.

They have power to shut up the sky so that no rain falls during the time they are prophesying. They have power to turn the waters into blood, and to strike the earth with every kind of disaster as often as they want.
When they have finished telling their message, the beast that comes up out of the bottomless pit will fight against them. It will defeat them and kill them.
Their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city. In a spiritual way that city is called Sodom and Egypt. It is where their Lord was nailed to a cross.
For three and a half days, people from every people, tribe, language, and nation will stare at their dead bodies and will not let them be buried.
The people who live on the earth will be happy about their death and will celebrate. They will send each other gifts, because these two prophets had caused them so much pain.
But after three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered them, and they stood up on their feet. Great fear came over everyone who saw them.
Then the two witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here!" And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies watched.

At that same moment there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell down. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake. The rest were terrified, and they gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second terrible thing is past. Look, the third terrible thing is coming soon.
The seventh angel blew his trumpet. Then there were loud voices in heaven saying, "The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will rule forever and ever!"
And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones in front of God's throne, fell on their faces and worshipped God.
They said: "We thank you, Lord God Almighty, who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to rule.

The nations were angry, but now your anger has come. The time has come to judge the dead, and to reward your servants the prophets, your holy people, and all who fear your name, both small and great. The time has come to destroy those who destroy the earth."
Then God's temple in heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant could be seen inside his temple. There were flashes of lightning, loud sounds, thunder, an earthquake, and a great hailstorm.
Then a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman dressed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant, and she cried out in pain because she was about to give birth.
Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and threw them down to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it could eat her child the moment it was born.
She gave birth to a son, a boy, who will rule all the nations with an iron rod. Her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.
The woman ran away into the desert, to a place God had made ready for her, where she would be taken care of for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and its angels fought back.
But the dragon was not strong enough, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down. It is that old snake called the devil and Satan, who fools the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ have come. For the one who accuses our brothers and sisters has been thrown down. He accused them in front of our God day and night.
They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the message they told. They did not love their own lives so much that they were afraid to die.
So be glad, you heavens, and all who live in them! But how terrible for the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you. He is very angry, because he knows that his time is short."
When the dragon saw that it had been thrown down to the earth, it chased after the woman who had given birth to the boy.

But the woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she could fly to her place in the desert. There she would be taken care of, away from the snake, for a time, two times, and half a time.
Then the snake poured water out of its mouth like a river after the woman, to sweep her away with the flood.
But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured out of its mouth.
Then the dragon became very angry with the woman. It went off to make war against the rest of her children, those who obey God's commands and hold on to what Jesus said.
Then I stood on the sand of the seashore. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on its horns, and on its heads were names that insulted God.
The beast I saw looked like a leopard. Its feet were like a bear's feet, and its mouth was like a lion's mouth. The dragon gave the beast its power, its throne, and great authority.
One of the beast's heads looked as if it had been wounded to death, but the deadly wound was healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
People worshipped the dragon, because it had given its authority to the beast. They also worshipped the beast and said, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?"
The beast was given a mouth to boast and to insult God. It was given authority to act for forty-two months.
It opened its mouth to insult God, to insult his name and the place where he lives, and those who live in heaven.
It was allowed to make war against God's holy people and to defeat them. And it was given authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.
Everyone who lives on the earth will worship the beast, everyone whose name has not been written, since the world was made, in the book of life belonging to the Lamb who was killed.
Anyone who has ears should listen.

Anyone who is meant to be taken prisoner will be taken prisoner. Anyone who is meant to be killed with the sword will be killed with the sword. This is why God's holy people need patient endurance and faith.
Then I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.
It used all the authority of the first beast on its behalf. It made the earth and the people who live on it worship the first beast, whose deadly wound had been healed.
It did great miracles, even making fire come down from heaven to the earth while people watched.

Because of the miracles it was allowed to do for the first beast, it fooled the people who live on the earth. It told them to make a statue to honour the beast that was wounded by the sword and yet lived.
The second beast was allowed to give breath to the statue of the first beast, so that the statue could speak. It could have everyone killed who refused to worship the statue.
It forced everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.
No one could buy or sell anything unless he had this mark, which is the name of the beast or the number of its name.
This calls for wisdom. Anyone who understands should work out the number of the beast, because it is the number of a man. Its number is six hundred and sixty-six.

Then I looked, and there in front of me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion. With him were one hundred and forty-four thousand people who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.
I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like loud thunder. The sound I heard was like people playing their harps.

They sang a new song in front of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred and forty-four thousand who had been bought back from the earth.

These are the ones who did not make themselves impure with women, for they kept themselves pure. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were bought back from among people as the first harvest for God and the Lamb.
No lie was found in their mouths. They are without fault.
Then I saw another angel flying high in the sky. He had the Good News that lasts forever to announce to the people who live on the earth, to every nation, tribe, language, and people.
He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the time has come for him to judge. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the springs of water!"
A second angel followed him and said, "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the great! She made all the nations drink the wine of her sexual sin, which brings God's anger."
A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and its statue, and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
he will also drink the wine of God's anger, poured full strength into the cup of his anger. He will suffer pain with fire and burning sulphur in front of the holy angels and the Lamb.
The smoke of their pain rises forever and ever. There is no rest day or night for those who worship the beast and its statue, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name."
This is why God's holy people need to keep going patiently. They obey God's commands and keep their faith in Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write this: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their hard work, because the good things they did will go with them."
Then I looked, and there was a white cloud. Sitting on the cloud was someone like a son of man. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.

Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to the one sitting on the cloud, "Use your sickle and gather the harvest, because the time has come. The harvest of the earth is ripe!"
So the one sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.
Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

And another angel, who has power over fire, came from the altar. He called in a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle, "Use your sharp sickle and gather the bunches of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe!"
So the angel swung his sickle on the earth, gathered its grapes, and threw them into the great winepress of God's anger.
The grapes were crushed in the winepress outside the city. Blood flowed out of the winepress, as high as the horses' bridles, for about three hundred kilometres.
Then I saw another great and amazing sign in heaven: seven angels with the seven last disasters. They are the last, because with them God's anger is finished.

I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Standing beside the sea of glass were those who had won the victory over the beast, its statue, and the number of its name. They were holding harps that God had given them.
They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb: "Great and amazing are the things you do, Lord God Almighty! Right and true are your ways, King of the nations.
Who will not fear you, Lord, and give glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All the nations will come and worship you, because the right things you have done have been shown to all."
After this I looked, and the temple in heaven, the holy tent of God's covenant, was opened.
The seven angels with the seven disasters came out of the temple. They were dressed in clean, shining linen, with gold belts around their chests.
Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven gold bowls full of the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.
The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power. No one could go into the temple until the seven disasters of the seven angels were finished.
Then I heard a loud voice from the temple say to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth!"
The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the earth. Ugly, painful sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshipped its statue.
The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. It turned into blood like the blood of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water, and they turned into blood.
Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are fair in these judgments, Holy One, you who are and who were.
They poured out the blood of your holy people and your prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve it."
And I heard the altar answer: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and right."
The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was allowed to burn people with fire.
People were burned by the great heat, and they cursed the name of God, who has power over these disasters. But they refused to turn away from their sins and give him glory.
The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom was covered in darkness. People chewed their tongues because of the pain.
They cursed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, but they still did not turn away from what they had done.
The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates. Its water dried up to make a way ready for the kings from the east.
Then I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
They are spirits of demons that do miracles. They go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.
"Look, I am coming like a thief! Blessed is the one who stays awake and keeps his clothes ready, so that he will not walk around naked and be seen in his shame."
Then the spirits gathered the kings together at the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.
The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple, saying, "It is done!"

Then there were flashes of lightning, loud sounds, and thunder, and a huge earthquake. There has never been an earthquake like it since people have lived on the earth. It was that great and that strong.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. God remembered Babylon the great, and gave her the cup filled with the wine of his fierce anger.
Every island ran away, and the mountains could not be found.
Huge hailstones, each weighing about thirty-four kilograms, fell from the sky on people. And people cursed God because of the hail, because it was such a terrible disaster.
Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you how God will punish the great prostitute who sits by many waters.
The kings of the earth did sexual sin with her, and the people who live on the earth became drunk on the wine of her sexual sin."

Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a bright red beast. The beast was covered with names that insulted God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was dressed in purple and bright red, and she was covered with gold, jewels, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup full of disgusting things and the filth of her sexual sin.
On her forehead a name was written, a name with a secret meaning: "BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE DISGUSTING THINGS OF THE EARTH."
I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God's holy people, the blood of those who died for telling about Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly amazed.
Then the angel said to me, "Why are you amazed? I will explain to you the secret of the woman and of the beast she rides, the one with seven heads and ten horns.

The beast you saw was once alive, but now it is not. It is about to come up out of the bottomless pit and go to its destruction. The people who live on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life since the world was made, will be amazed when they see the beast. It was, and now is not, and yet it will come.
This calls for a wise mind. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is ruling now, and the other has not yet come. When he does come, he must stay only a short time.
The beast that was, and now is not, is an eighth king. It belongs with the seven, and it is going to its destruction.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet started to rule. But they will be given authority as kings for one hour, together with the beast.
They all have one purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
They will make war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will win against them, because he is Lord of lords and King of kings. And with him will be those he has called and chosen, his faithful followers."
Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will leave her ruined and naked. They will eat her flesh and burn her up with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his plan. They will agree to give their kingdom to the beast, until what God has said comes true.
The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth."
After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was lit up by his glory.
He shouted with a mighty voice: "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the great! She has become a home for demons, a prison for every evil spirit, a prison for every unclean and hated bird.

For all the nations have drunk the wine of her sexual sin, which brings God's anger. The kings of the earth did sexual sin with her, and the traders of the earth grew rich from her great wealth and her love of luxury."
Then I heard another voice from heaven say: "Come out of her, my people, so that you do not take part in her sins, and so that you do not receive any of her disasters.
For her sins are piled up as high as heaven, and God has remembered the wrong things she has done.
Pay her back as she has paid others. Pay her back twice as much for what she has done. Mix her a drink twice as strong in the cup she mixed for others.
Give her as much pain and sorrow as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she says, 'I sit as a queen. I am not a widow, and I will never be sad.'
So her disasters will come in one day: death, sorrow, and hunger. She will be burned up with fire, because the Lord God who judges her is mighty.
The kings of the earth who did sexual sin with her and shared her luxury will cry and weep over her when they see the smoke of her burning.
They will stand far away, afraid of her pain, and say: 'How terrible, how terrible for you, great city, Babylon, city of power! In one hour your punishment has come!'
The traders of the earth will cry and be sad over her, because no one buys their goods any more:
goods of gold, silver, jewels, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and bright red cloth; all kinds of sweet-smelling wood; all kinds of things made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
cinnamon, spice, incense, perfume, and frankincense; wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; cattle, sheep, horses, and carriages; and human beings sold as slaves.
They will say, 'All the good things your heart wanted are gone from you. All your riches and beauty have disappeared, and you will never find them again.'
The traders who sold these things and became rich from her will stand far away, afraid of her pain. They will cry and be sad,
and say: 'How terrible, how terrible for the great city! She was dressed in fine linen, purple, and bright red, and covered with gold, jewels, and pearls!
In one hour all this great wealth has been destroyed!' Every ship's captain, everyone who travels by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, stood far away.
When they saw the smoke of her burning, they cried out, 'Was there ever a city like this great city?'

They threw dust on their heads and cried out, weeping and sad: 'How terrible, how terrible for the great city! All who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth. And in one hour she has been destroyed!'
"Be glad about her, heaven! Be glad, God's holy people, apostles, and prophets! For God has judged her for the way she treated you."

Then a mighty angel picked up a stone the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea. He said: "This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down with violence, and it will never be found again.

The music of harp players, singers, flute players, and trumpeters will never be heard in you again. No worker of any trade will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.

The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voices of the bridegroom and the bride will never be heard in you again. Your traders were the great people of the world, and by your witchcraft all the nations were fooled.
In her was found the blood of prophets and of God's holy people, and of all who have been killed on the earth."
After this I heard what sounded like the loud voice of a huge crowd in heaven, shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God,
for his judgments are true and fair. He has judged the great prostitute who ruined the earth with her sexual sin. He has punished her for the blood of his servants."
And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up forever and ever."
The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshipped God, who sits on the throne. They said: "Amen! Hallelujah!"
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, all who fear him, both small and great!"
Then I heard what sounded like a huge crowd, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For the Lord our God Almighty rules!
Let us be glad and full of joy, and give him glory! For the wedding of the Lamb has come, and his bride has made herself ready.
She has been given fine linen, bright and clean, to wear." The fine linen stands for the right things that God's holy people have done.
Then the angel said to me, "Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!" And he added, "These are the true words of God."

Then I fell down at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Do not do that! I am a servant like you and like your brothers and sisters who hold on to what Jesus told. Worship God! For telling about Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there was a white horse. Its rider is called Faithful and True. He judges fairly and makes war for what is right.
His eyes are like flames of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has a name written on him that no one knows except himself.
He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is The Word of God.
The armies of heaven followed him, riding on white horses and dressed in fine linen, white and clean.
Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword to strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He crushes the grapes in the winepress of the fierce anger of God Almighty.
On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
Then I saw an angel standing in the sun. He shouted in a loud voice to all the birds flying in the sky, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
so that you can eat the flesh of kings, army leaders, and mighty men, the flesh of horses and their riders, and the flesh of all people, free and slave, small and great."
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies gathered together to make war against the rider on the horse and his army.

But the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who had done miracles for it. By those miracles he had fooled those who received the mark of the beast and worshipped its statue. The two of them were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulphur.
The rest were killed with the sword that came out of the mouth of the rider on the horse. And all the birds ate their fill of their flesh.
Then I saw an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key to the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
He grabbed the dragon, that old snake, who is the devil and Satan, who fools the whole world. He tied him up for a thousand years.

He threw him into the bottomless pit, and shut and sealed it over him, so that he could not fool the nations any more until the thousand years were over. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

Then I saw thrones, and those sitting on them were given authority to judge. I also saw the souls of those whose heads had been cut off because they told about Jesus and preached the word of God. They had not worshipped the beast or its statue, and had not received its mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and ruled with Christ for a thousand years.
The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were over. This is the first resurrection.
Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will rule with him for a thousand years.
When the thousand years are over, Satan will be set free from his prison.
He will go out to fool the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gather them for battle. They will be as many as the grains of sand on the seashore.
They marched across the whole earth and surrounded the camp of God's holy people, the city he loves. But fire came down from heaven and burned them up.
And the devil, who fooled them, was thrown into the lake of fire and sulphur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will suffer pain day and night forever and ever.
Then I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The earth and the sky ran away from his face, and no place was found for them.

And I saw the dead, great and small, standing in front of the throne. Books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged by what they had done, as it was written in the books.
The sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. Each person was judged by what he had done.
Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
Anyone whose name was not found written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, because the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no more sea.
I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God. It was made ready like a bride dressed beautifully for her husband.
And I heard a loud voice from the throne say, "Look! God's home is now with people. He will live with them, and they will be his people. God himself will be with them and be their God.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death, no more sadness, no more crying, and no more pain. The old way of things has passed away."
The one sitting on the throne said, "Look, I am making everything new!" Then he said, "Write this down, because these words are faithful and true."
He said to me, "It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To anyone who is thirsty, I will give water from the spring of the water of life for free.
The one who wins the victory will receive all this. I will be his God, and he will be my child.

But the cowards, those who do not believe, those who do disgusting things, murderers, those who do sexual sin, those who practise witchcraft, those who worship idols, and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulphur. This is the second death."
Then one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last disasters came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
He carried me away in the Spirit to a great, high mountain. He showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.
It shone with the glory of God. Its brightness was like a very precious jewel, like jasper, clear as crystal.
It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
The angel who spoke with me had a gold measuring rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
The city was laid out as a square, as long as it was wide. He measured the city with the rod. It was about two thousand two hundred kilometres. Its length, width, and height were all the same.
He measured its wall too, and it was about sixty-five metres thick, by the human measure the angel was using.
The wall was made of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, as clear as glass.
The foundations of the city wall were decorated with every kind of jewel. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each gate was made from a single pearl. The main street of the city was made of pure gold, as clear as glass.
I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.
The city does not need the sun or the moon to shine on it, because the glory of God gives it light, and the Lamb is its lamp.
The nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth will bring their glory into it.
Its gates will never be shut during the day, and there will be no night there.
The glory and honour of the nations will be brought into it.
Nothing unclean will ever enter it, and no one who does disgusting things or tells lies. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will enter.
Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, clear as crystal. It flowed from the throne of God and of the Lamb,

down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, which bears twelve kinds of fruit, a new crop every month. The leaves of the tree are for healing the nations.
There will no longer be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.
They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will give them light. And they will rule forever and ever.
The angel said to me, "These words are faithful and true. The Lord, the God who gives his Spirit to the prophets, sent his angel to show his servants what must happen soon."
"Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who obeys the words of the prophecy in this book."
I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown them to me.
But he said to me, "Do not do that! I am a servant like you, and like your brothers the prophets, and like all who obey the words of this book. Worship God!"
Then he told me, "Do not keep the words of the prophecy in this book secret, because the time is near.
Let the one who does wrong keep on doing wrong. Let the one who is filthy keep on being filthy. Let the one who does right keep on doing right. Let the one who is holy keep on being holy."
"Look, I am coming soon! I bring my reward with me, to pay back each person for what he has done.
I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
Blessed are those who obey his commands, so that they have the right to the tree of life and can go through the gates into the city.
Outside are the dogs, those who practise witchcraft, those who do sexual sin, the murderers, those who worship idols, and everyone who loves and tells lies.
I, Jesus, have sent my angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the root and the family of David, the bright morning star."
The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Let anyone who hears say, "Come!" Let anyone who is thirsty come. Let anyone who wants it take the water of life for free.
I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy in this book: if anyone adds anything to them, God will add to him the disasters written in this book.
And if anyone takes away any words from this book of prophecy, God will take away his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are written about in this book.
The one who tells these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen! Come, Lord Jesus!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with all God's people. Amen.
